title: Deputy Manager Product Training Content Developer
description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Product Training Content Developer to create engaging, high-quality training materials for our product and skill-based learning initiatives. This role focuses on developing content for offline training, social media, and Learning Management Systems (LMS), ensuring it is easy to understand and effective in educating our target audience—promoters and sales staff.

The ideal candidate will have expertise in Microsoft PowerPoint, multimedia design, smartphone industry knowledge, and project management, with a passion for continuous improvement through quality assurance and feedback analysis. The candidate will also conduct competition analysis and market visits to ensure our training content remains current and impactful. Collaboration with cross-functional teams is essential to deliver content that meets the highest standards and aligns with our business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop high-quality product and skill-based training content for offline and digital platforms (e.g., social media and LMS platforms)
* Conduct in-depth competition analysis and market visits to gather relevant insights and enhance training material
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure content accuracy and alignment with business and product goals
* Ensure continuous improvement of training content through feedback collection, analysis, and quality assurance
* Develop learning content focused on soft skills, customer service, and sales techniques to complement product knowledge
* Adapt content for various channels, including physical training, online learning, and social media campaigns
* Manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Master’s degree in Retail Management and/or Marketing & Sales from a reputed institution
* 4+ years of experience in content development or product training in the smartphone industry (or related technology field)
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and experience managing/preparing content for LMS platforms
* Strong understanding of smartphone technology and market trends
* Ability to conduct market research and competition analysis
* A creative mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
* Ability to communicate complex product features and selling points in a simple, engaging, and audience-friendly manner
* Strong on-camera presence and ability to present naturally and confidently for learning videos, KOL-style product videos, social media content, and other digital learning formats
* Excellent speaking, presentation, and training delivery skills, with the ability to confidently engage and influence sales and field audiences

**Key Competencies**

* Ability to translate complex technical information into easy-to-understand training materials
* Comfortable presenting on camera and creating engaging KOL-style learning, product, and sales videos
* Strong training delivery skills, including the ability to explain, demonstrate, and simplify product and skill concepts
* Confident public speaking and strong facilitator presence

title: Lead Developer Advocate
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Trailblazer Relations APAC is a team of creative, highly technical advocates, community builders, and program leaders. We inspire, enable, engage, and support the ever-growing Trailblazer community across Asia Pacific. We help Trailblazers succeed on the Salesforce Platform and use cutting-edge technologies like AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
  
  
Our work goes well beyond developer advocacy. We grow and support Trailblazer Community Groups, MVPs, and Group Leaders. We run community events and executive engagements. We also partner with customers, partners, and local ecosystems across the region. For developers, we write blog posts, produce video content, host workshops, and engage in person and virtually at Salesforce and third-party events.
  
  
We work closely with Trailblazer Community, Architect Evangelists, marketing, product management, engineering, and product marketing. We are the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC, bringing regional perspectives into the company to shape the Salesforce experience, especially around AI and data.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You're a seasoned technologist who thinks in systems. You know which tool and which feature fits the problem. That means choosing between probabilistic AI and deterministic code, and between visual builders and building from scratch. You're equally comfortable with front-end and back-end languages and APIs, and you're eager to explore new paradigms in AI-driven development.
  
  
You're curious about the full Salesforce portfolio, including platforms like MuleSoft and Heroku, and you enjoy connecting them to solve real problems. You show the "art of the possible" with prototypes that span multiple products.
  
  
You can shift between audiences, from students and new developers in emerging markets to senior architects and CTOs in mature ones. You're a lighthouse in the community, comfortable on camera and on stage in front of audiences of hundreds or thousands. You're ready to travel across APAC to meet them.
  
  
**You Are Excited About This Role Because You Will**

* Design technical content, reference apps, and demos that span AIforce, Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the wider Salesforce platform built for reuse across events and year-long regional programs.
* Collaborate with Architect Evangelists to incorporate architect content into the programs, campaigns and hands-on activities in the region.
* Contextualize global advocacy campaigns for APAC. For example, adapt one global message into narratives that work for a student-heavy market like India and an enterprise-heavy one like ANZ.
* Own the technical workstreams for flagship events such as World Tours, TDX, and Dreamforce. Design high-scale engagement models for 1000+ audiences, using gamification and interactive coding.
* Own content strategy and assets for programs such as Journey to Salesforce (J2S)
* Delegate component building while personally owning final testing and quality assurance.
* Identify gaps between product, market, and developer needs. Take real-world friction back to product and engineering as the "voice of the Trailblazer."
* Represent the team in strategic discussions, so Trailblazer and developer needs are prioritized in marketing motions.
* Coach non-technical team members, community leaders, and external presenters to deliver technical content at scale.
* Work with Community Group Leaders and MVPs to help them grow and succeed.

**We're Excited About You, Because You Have**

* 8+ years of experience implementing on the Salesforce Platform, with architect-level design skills.
* Recognized cross-product expertise, with a proven ability to build prototypes that connect multiple Salesforce products. Certifications or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven expertise in web applications, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Apex, and APIs, plus hands-on curiosity about AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills, and experience making complex concepts accessible.
* Proven ability to influence without authority across regional stakeholders.
* Experience coaching and mentoring others, and a track record of raising the bar on code and content quality.
* An understanding of how quickly the ways people consume content and share experiences are shifting.
* A strategic mind and strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You work well solo and as a collaborative team player.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
**About Job Profile**
Experience: 2+ yrs
  
  
Salary: As per industry norms
  
  
Location: R&I Park, IIT Delhi
  
  
Description: We are seeking a skilled and proactive Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our team at R&I Park, IIT Delhi. In this role, you will develop high-reliability embedded firmware on STM32, TI, and Espressif microcontrollers, implement real-time control algorithms for power conversion systems, and work across hardware-software integration, communication protocols, and system validation.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Develop embedded firmware on STM32, TI, and Espressif microcontrollers using C and C++.
* Implement real-time control algorithms for power conversion systems.
* Develop firmware architecture, state machines, fault handling, and safety mechanisms.
* Configure and optimize MCU peripherals such as ADC, DMA, PWM, CAN, Timers, and Flash.
* Implement communication protocols including CAN, bootloader functionality, alongside OTA update mechanisms.
* Perform board bring-up, hardware-software integration, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Analyze system performance using oscilloscopes, CAN analyzers, and debugging tools.
* Support system validation, testing, and issue resolution.
* Create and maintain technical documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with control, hardware, and validation teams during product development.

Skill(s) required
  
  

* Strong Embedded C/C++ programming skills, along with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience with STM32, TI, and Espressif platforms.
* Working experience in both Baremetal and RTOS-based firmwares, with a good understanding of real-time systems and interrupt-driven firmware.
* Deep understanding of bootloaders, Flash memory, and communication protocols.
* Experience with ADC acquisition, PWM generation, and control-loop implementation.
* Working experience with IoT protocols including WiFi, BLE, MQTT, and Websockets.
* Knowledge of CAN communication and automotive diagnostics.
* Familiarity with Git version control and experience using debuggers, oscilloscopes, and communication analyzers.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Exposure to EV Mobility domain, automotive embedded systems, and EV power electronics (Preferred).
* Knowledge of PCB design principles, digital control systems, and power converter topologies (Preferred).
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink model-based development or UDS diagnostics (Preferred).

Eligibility
  
  

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Passionate engineer with strong hands-on problem-solving and root-cause troubleshooting abilities.
* Experience or strong interest in EV / Power Electronics and real-time control systems.
* Self-starter capable of driving hardware-software integration and debugging independently.
* Collaborative team player who documents work cleanly and communicates effectively.

What we Offer
  
  

* Competitive compensation as per industry standards.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge embedded systems, power electronics, and IoT.
* Access to world-class lab and R&D facilities at R&I Park, IIT Delhi.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented engineering culture.

title: Embedded and Project Team Lead
description:
**About Job Profile**
Experience: 8+ yrs
  
  
Salary: As per industry norms
  
  
Location: R&I Park, IIT Delhi
  
  
Description: CLUIX is seeking a high-caliber Embedded and Project Team Lead to head embedded firmware development and oversee end-to-end hardware-software engineering projects. In this hybrid technical and project management role, you will architect robust, low-power embedded systems for our precision water testing devices, lead a multidisciplinary engineering team, and manage product delivery timelines from prototype to mass production.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead and mentor the embedded firmware and IoT engineering team, setting architecture standards, code quality benchmarks, and sprint goals.
* Manage cross-functional engineering project delivery, coordinating electronics, firmware, mechanical design, chemistry R&D, and QA.
* Architect, develop, and review production-grade firmware in C/C++ on ARM Cortex microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, etc.) and RTOS.
* Define hardware-software interface specifications, sensor data acquisition algorithms, power management logic, and wireless telemetry (BLE, Wi-Fi, 4G-LTE/NB-IoT).
* Manage engineering project roadmaps, sprint planning, Gantt charts, risk matrices, and bill of materials (BOM) readiness.
* Oversee hardware board bring-up, system-level debugging, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and compliance certification (CE, FCC, RoHS).
* Implement automated firmware build pipelines, version control (Git), OTA update mechanisms, and CI/CD test rigs.
* Drive root-cause failure analysis for field issues and execute timely engineering change orders (ECOs).

Skill(s) required
  
  

* Expertise in embedded C/C++, RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr), bare-metal firmware, and microcontroller architectures.
* Strong technical project management skills using Agile/Scrum, Jira/ClickUp, risk analysis, and engineering milestone tracking.
* Proficiency with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, MQTT, CoAP) and sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with hardware design principles, reading complex schematics, PCB layout reviews, and lab tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
* Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and manage team dynamics while maintaining high engineering rigor.

Eligibility
  
  

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), Computer Science, or Embedded Systems.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems and firmware development, with at least 2+ years leading engineering teams or hardware projects.
* Proven experience delivering commercial-grade IoT/embedded hardware products to production.

What we are looking for
  
  

* A hands-on technical leader who balances deep embedded engineering expertise with structured project management.
* Proactive problem-solver committed to code quality, product durability, and timely milestones.
* Excellent communicator capable of translating complex engineering details across multidisciplinary teams.

What we Offer
  
  

* Lead key engineering initiatives at an innovative clean-tech startup.
* Work with cutting-edge optical, chemical, and IoT sensing technologies.
* World-class lab and prototyping infrastructure at IIT Delhi R&I Park.
* Competitive salary package with strong professional recognition and growth.

title: Manager, TSG Data Engineering
description:
**Company Profile**
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives.
  
  
**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**
This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Technical Delivery (50%)**

* Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.
* Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members.
* Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate.
* Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate.
* Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams.
* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

**Team management (25%)**

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.
* Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members.
* Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices.
* Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success.
* Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery.
* Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped.

**Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)**

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

**About You**

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.

**Data Engineering - Technical Skills**

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory
* Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app
* DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform
* Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI, etc.

**Experience**

* 8-10 experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.

description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior role who can independently handle a software module/function which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management and communication. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for coaching and mentoring of the team from technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise scale applications at Bain.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects and Project/Product Managers.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing etc. through internal/external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager and Product Owner to improve team performance. Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with Zero D.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience in managing a group of developers from technical leadership standpoint.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree.

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core
* Languages: C#, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/Lib: Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions
* Web frameworks/Lib: React
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache

Placeholderworks is an AI engineering firm focused on turning AI concepts into robust, production-grade systems. We design, build, deploy, and support AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and retrieval systems that integrate with existing business workflows. Our team works closely with clients to solve real-world problems through practical, reliable, and scalable engineering solutions.

* 2–4 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or a related technical role.

* Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and integrating third-party systems.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, and AI agent workflows.
* Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and document-processing pipelines.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases, Git, debugging, and software testing.
* Experience with Docker and at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and deliver reliable, maintainable software.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work directly with clients, clarify requirements, and translate feedback into technical improvements.
* Demonstrated ownership of projects from requirements gathering through deployment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying AI-powered applications or LLM workflows in production.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms, CRMs, or legacy systems.

* Resolving deployment challenges and improving system reliability.

If you enjoy solving real-world problems, working directly with clients, and taking AI-powered solutions from concept to production, we would love to hear from you. At Placeholderworks, the goal is not just to build AI. It is to make AI work in the real world.

Full Stack Engineers own specific feature areas within Artemis and the broader Demand Generation Suite product workstreams and are responsible for both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users. For Artemis, this includes the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client-ready output views.

This is a delivery-focused engineering role. The ability to ship complete, tested features independently — without waiting for a backend or frontend specialist to hand off — is the core contribution. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, leading troubleshooting efforts, directing code deployments, and mentoring junior engineers.

Feature Development

Frontend and Data Visualization 

* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, with a focus on marketing analytics interfaces: channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, model configuration workflows, and executive-ready recommendation outputs.
* Write and maintain database queries, schema migrations, and data access logic for Artemis data models. Optimize for the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.

Quality and Collaboration

  s.

Technical

* Strong CSS skills and experience working with component libraries and design systems.

description:
Try it here! https://www.meet-cedric.com/

**Cedric · 0–2 years of experience**

Most people don’t need another tool to manage. They need help getting through the work they already have.

That’s what we’re building at Cedric. An AI assistant that connects with everyday work tools, follows conversations and helps move things forward. Meeting follow-ups, task updates, recurring workflows and the small jobs that quietly eat up the day.

We’re looking for a junior developer who wants to build useful software and take an active role in an early-stage product.

**The role**

You’ll work directly with our CTO and a small team to build features, develop integrations and improve how Cedric works for users.

The work spans the application, external APIs and AI workflows. You might spend one day improving onboarding and the next figuring out why an integration failed or how to make an AI action more reliable.

You’ll have guidance, regular feedback and room to take on more responsibility as you develop.

**What you’ll work on**

* Product features: Build and improve the interfaces and backend services people use to interact with Cedric.
* Integrations: Connect Cedric with communication, calendar, project management and other work tools.
* AI workflows: Help turn user requests into actions, with clear approval steps and sensible handling when something goes wrong.
* Reliability: Investigate bugs, handle API failures and improve the consistency of recurring tasks.
* User experience: Reduce friction in onboarding and make features easier to understand and use.
* Engineering quality: Write readable code, contribute to code reviews and test the changes you ship.

**What we’re looking for**

You’re early in your career, but you’ve already spent time building things. You can explain your decisions, work through a problem and ask for help when you need it.

You should have:

* Solid programming fundamentals and experience with at least one modern programming language.
* Some experience building web applications through personal projects, university work, internships or employment.
* A working understanding of APIs, databases and Git.
* An interest in how AI products work beyond the chat interface.
* Good written and spoken English.
* The ability to organise your work and communicate clearly in a remote team.
* Attention to detail, especially when your code affects a user’s data or triggers an action.
* Fresh graduates are welcome. Show us what you can build and how you think.

**Nice to have**

* Experience using LLM APIs.
* Projects involving automation or third-party integrations.
* Familiarity with authentication, webhooks or background jobs.
* Experience deploying an application and maintaining it after launch.
* Contributions to open-source projects.
* You don’t need to tick every box to apply.

**Why join Cedric**

Cedric was built through Swiss Founders Fund’s venture studio in Zurich. We’re a small team working on a practical problem: helping people spend less time coordinating work and more time getting it done.

Joining at this stage means:

* Working directly with our CTO and founding team.
* Contributing to product decisions and seeing your work reach users.
* Getting experience across product development, integrations and applied AI.
* Learning how software behaves outside a demo, with real users and unexpected edge cases.
* Taking ownership of larger pieces of the product as your skills grow.

* Act as the single point of technical authority for the implementation agency; review deliverables against contracted scope and phase-gate validation criteria
* Chair architecture review boards and technical acceptance sessions across all phases; recommend acceptance, conditional acceptance, or rework to leadership
* Track SLA adherence (uptime, RTO/RPO, incident resolution) and quality metrics; drive corrective action

**Migration, Onboarding & Stakeholder Interface**

* APIs & Integration: REST / OpenAPI, GraphQL basics, webhook design, event-driven integration, API gateway patterns
* Observability & SRE: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger / Tempo; SLI/SLO/errorbudget methodology; RTO/RPO planning; incident management
* Security & Compliance: OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF, Zero Trust Architecture, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, CIS controls, CERT-In guidelines, DPDP Act 2023
* AI/ML Understanding: Working understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, MLOps, and AI-assisted developer tooling (not required to code, but must make platform-level trade-offs)
* Communication: Executive presentation to leadership and consumer stakeholders; ability to defend architectural positions in review boards; ability to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical audiences and build consensus across engineering, security, and business stakeholders

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: D365 F&O Architect
description:
**Job Title:**
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Architect (Contract, Remote)

**Location:**
Remote (candidates in India / SE Asia time zones with NZ business-hours overlap MUST, NO EXCEPTIONS). If you cannot start 6AM IST onwards, the application will NOT be considered

**Contract Length:**
Initial term with strong likelihood of extension based on programme needs and performance

**Engagement Type:**
Contract

**About the Role**

We're looking for a senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Architect to join a complex, multi-workstream implementation for a well-established multinational client. The programme is in its final stabilization phase — most core functionality is built and the focus now is on finishing touches, defect resolution, and closing a handful of high-priority gaps across billing, invoicing, and compliance. This is not a greenfield build; it's a high-stakes, time-critical push to go-live across several parallel workstreams.

**What You'll Be Working On**

* Subscription Billing — consumption/usage-based billing scenarios, including diagnosing and redesigning credit note and re-invoice (rebill) logic where current functionality has known defects
* Electronic Reporting (ER) and/or SSRS — customer-facing document design (invoices, credit notes, statements), including evaluating current tooling choices and recommending the right path forward
* Peppol eInvoicing — architecting the solution to meet an upcoming government eInvoicing compliance deadline, including format mapping (UBL/Peppol), Access Point integration strategy, and rollout scope
* Integration between D365 F&O and CE (Customer Engagement) modules — customer agreements, contracts, and downstream billing processes
* Providing architectural oversight and technical direction across multiple concurrent workstreams (sales, billing, project operations, and more), working alongside existing functional and technical consultants

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across F&O and connected CE modules for the remaining programme scope
* Diagnose root causes of defects (code vs. configuration vs. process) and define the correct technical path forward, favoring standard/native functionality over custom code wherever possible
* Lead technical design for Peppol/eInvoicing compliance work
* Review and guide X++ development, ER/SSRS form design, and integration architecture
* Provide clear, decisive technical recommendations to stakeholders operating under tight go-live timelines
* Mentor and coordinate with existing functional and technical consultants on the programme
* Communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical trade-offs into clear options and recommendations

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years in Microsoft Dynamics AX/D365 F&O, with demonstrated architect-level experience (not just functional or technical delivery)
* Strong hands-on experience with Subscription Billing module
* Deep expertise in Electronic Reporting (ER) and/or SSRS for complex, calculation-heavy document design
* Experience with Peppol/UBL-based eInvoicing standards and integration patterns (strongly preferred)
* Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex X++ code-level defects, not just configure standard functionality
* Experience architecting integrations between D365 F&O and D365 CE (Sales/Customer Engagement)
* A track record of pushing clients toward standard functionality over unnecessary customization
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, go-live-critical environment with multiple concurrent workstreams
* Excellent stakeholder communication — able to give clear, confident technical direction under pressure

**What's on Offer**

* Contract engagement with strong potential for extension
* Remote-friendly, with meaningful overlap required with NZ business hours
* High-impact role architecting the final, most complex pieces of a major enterprise programme
* Opportunity to work alongside an existing team of functional and technical consultants on a well-established multinational client

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates apply here OR send their CV along with a brief summary of relevant D365 F&O architecture and Subscription Billing / eInvoicing experience.

title: Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)
description:
**New Delhi**
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
You’ll join Bain’s Sustainability Practice, which helps our clients make critical decisions at the core of their business strategy. Our work spans sustainability strategy, the environmental and social impact of operations, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability-related growth and cost opportunities.
  
  
We help ensure sustainability efforts are grounded in business fundamentals, demonstrate a clear return on investment, and become firmly embedded within our clients’ strategies and operations.
  
  
As part of the Sustainability Practice, you’ll collaborate globally with colleagues across Bain, including client-facing teams and digital and technical specialists, to develop innovative perspectives, products, and solutions that help our clients achieve results.
  
  
**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**
As a Practice Consultant focused on Sustainability, Digital & AI, you’ll be a critical member of our Sustainability Practice. From day one, you’ll bring analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management, and leadership skills to help advance the practice’s annual and longer-term goals.
  
  
You’ll support case teams in delivering results for clients, help build new intellectual property and solutions, and contribute to global collaboration and our external visibility and differentiation.
  
  
A key part of your role will be exploring how AI, digital tools, automation, and emerging technologies can strengthen our sustainability solutions. You’ll work with technical specialists and practice colleagues to translate sustainability hypotheses and business needs into practical tools and prototypes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Solution design, development, deployment, and delivery
  
  

* Own and maintain the Sustainability Practice’s intellectual property and solution backlog, supporting competitive research, gap identification, and research into ecosystem offerings, partners, and emerging AI and digital tools.
* Conduct analysis and support business case development for solution investments.
* Develop intellectual property, including global reports, research briefs, market overviews, and solution- and topic-specific materials tailored to sectors and industries.
* Identify issues, develop hypotheses, execute analyses, translate data into meaningful insights, and present recommendations to key decision-makers.
* Support the day-to-day implementation of transformation projects, with a focus on delivering and operationalizing strategic initiatives that create meaningful business outcomes and impact.
* Provide hands-on support to clients and case teams in leveraging technology and AI solutions.
* Lead or contribute to the design and prototyping of AI-enabled tools and minimum viable products, working with technical specialists and our Production Engineering team to translate sustainability hypotheses into working prototypes that can be piloted with case teams and clients.
* Develop training materials that help colleagues use the latest intellectual property, AI capabilities, and digital tools.
* Surface new ideas, share learnings from pilots, and champion emerging technologies across the practice.
* Monitor developments in AI and emerging technologies and translate them into practical insights, tools, and training opportunities for colleagues.
* Identify opportunities to embed automation, analytics, and emerging technologies into our work to enhance delivery and impact.

Practice strategy, planning, and reporting
  
  

* Support win/loss learning and feedback loops for Sustainability Practice pitches and proposals, incorporating insights into our competitive knowledge base.
* Support planning for the commercialization of intellectual property and solutions, including developing investment business cases, ROI models, impact assessments, and commercialization plans.
* Support the development of sustainability diagnostic tools and frameworks, as applicable.
* Provide direct support for proposals.
* Support the collection, maintenance, and analysis of data relating to experts and commercial materials.

description:

Curriculum development, web development, frontend technologies, backend technologies, debugging, technical problem-solving, content review, stakeholder collaboration, quality assurance, analytical thinking.

title: Software Develpment Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To The Team**
The Identity Profile team is part of EG Identity and owns the profile data for every user across Expedia Group brands. We build and run the services behind the Universal Profile, including profile storage and APIs, the profile business events consumed across EG, and the integration paths into sign-in and checkout.
  
  
We are a hands-on, AI-forward team: engineers use agentic tools for development, triage, and documentation, with a strong emphasis on review quality and clear specs.
  
  
As a software engineer you will own critical, high-scale services. You will be a technical owner for multiple critical services which are in business critical. Reliability and latency here directly affect sign-in and booking for all EG brands. Lead design and delivery end to end. You will take ambiguous problems from design doc to production rollout, working with PMs, TPMs, and partner engineering teams. Raise the engineering bar. You will give thorough design and code reviews, mentor SDE 1/2 engineers, and help the team improve test coverage (including E2E and performance testing), documentation, and AI-assisted workflows. Strengthen operational excellence. You will improve alerting, runbooks, and incident learnings, and take part in on-call.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead design and implement products and solutions that are highly scalable with high-quality, clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* Find opportunities for process and technology improvements, and work towards adoption and implementation.
* Assist with supporting Production systems (includes investigating issues and working towards resolution)
* Exercise creativity and provide alternative solutions to a given problem removing roadblocks and driving issues to closure
* Create/update documentation for the purpose of sharing knowledge between team members
* Actively participate in group technology reviews to critique the work of self and others
* Participate and formulate user story creation in partnership with the team, product managers.
* Closely collaborate with Senior and Principal Developers, as well as the Product Manager, to find effective solutions to problems.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s in a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
* 5+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3+ years with a Master’s degree
* Experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin) and designing, REST/grpc/graphql APIs/MCP servers.
* Ability to design and build moderately complex, well-defined software systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud-computing platforms (e.g., Amazon Web Services)
* Experience with managing tier-0/tier-1 applications
* Experience with both relational and non-relational data stores
* Understanding of CI/CD methodologies, source control with Git, and monitoring/logging tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog)
* Experience working in an agile team environment, conducting peer reviews, and mentoring junior engineers
* Experience maintaining projects in production environments, including bug fixing and troubleshooting

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Development Engineer III (SDE-3) with strong expertise in Java backend development, distributed systems, and microservices architecture. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and scaling high-performance backend services that power last-mile delivery and fulfilment operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to drive technical initiatives independently. Experience in last-mile delivery, logistics, e-commerce, order management, or fulfilment systems is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* System Design: Drive the design of distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures.
* Last-Mile Solutions: Build and enhance services supporting delivery allocation, driver availability, order tracking, delivery promise, route optimisation, and delivery status management.
* Scalability and Performance: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, optimise database queries, and ensure services can handle high transaction volumes.
* Messaging and Integration: Design asynchronous workflows using Kafka or similar messaging platforms, ensuring reliable event processing and data consistency.

* Technical Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams, and contribute to architectural and technical decisions.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java.
* Strong knowledge of Java 11 or later, object-oriented programming, collections, concurrency, multithreading, and JVM fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, service-to-service communication, resiliency patterns, and eventual consistency.
* Experience with Kafka or equivalent event-streaming/message-broker technologies.
* Strong knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including query optimisation and data modelling.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with Redis or other caching solutions.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong debugging, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Understanding of delivery lifecycle management, including order assignment, dispatch, pickup, delivery, cancellations, and returns.
* Familiarity with driver/rider availability, capacity planning, delivery slot allocation, and order-to-driver assignment.
* Exposure to route optimisation, distance and ETA calculations, geospatial systems, and mapping services.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team you will work closely with consulting teams on a diverse range of advanced topics. You will collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs. You will provide technical support through deeper understanding of relevant software solutions and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of concepts/Minimum viable product to long term cases with enterprise grade software development as a critical enabler through the project level description of the role responsibilities and impact within the organization.
  
  
**You're Good At**
Web Application Development
  
  

* End to End high scale web-development experience but not just limited to architecting, design, planning, development and deployment

* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills; must be proactive and take initiative

* Provide system design recommendations based on technical requirements

GenAI & Agentic Systems Engineering
  
  

* Designing and shipping enterprise-grade GenAI features inside full stack architectures — not standalone notebooks or demos

* Applying guardrails and Responsible AI practice — prompt injection defence, PII and client-confidentiality handling, output validation, and a clear audit trail

Business Requirement Gathering and Collaboration
  
  

* Owning all or part of a software development engagement and integrating with cross-functional teams
* Establish credibility by thought partnering with demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on web development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies
* Communicate insights through sophisticated synthesis and packaging of results (including PPT slides and charts) with stakeholders / consulting teams; collecting, synthesizing, learnings & inputs into new best practices and methodologies
* Executing software development approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection
* Ensure proper sign‐off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents
* Able to build and sustain relationships with consulting MDPs to generate project work by self-leveraging regular connects
* Guides juniors on advanced software concepts and platforms, and helps in quality checks
* Contributes to team’s content & IP development
* Imparts technical trainings to team members and consulting cohort

Problem Solving
  
  

* You should be strong in solutioning with hands-on experience in software delivery, through the entire life cycle of software development. Strong problem solving skills with the ability to develop and codify knowledge and provide appropriate technical advice where required
* Comfort working with non-deterministic systems — debugging by evidence and evaluation rather than assumption

**Technical Skills**
Must have
  
  

* Experience in building high-performance web applications using -Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
* Leveraging SQL-Postgres for best performance
* On OOPs concepts, design patterns, responsive UI and Unit testing frameworks like Mockito, Junit, Jest.
* Knowledge of Material UI or And Design
* Knowledge of UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification
* Track record of designing, developing and supporting highly scalable, responsive web app
* Integrate UI with REST APIs to make the app production-ready
* Hands-on experience building applications on top of LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI preferred; OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent acceptable) that have been used by real users
* Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, DSPy or a comparable in-house equivalent)
* Implementing tool / function calling and structured output, including schema validation and error handling
* Logging, tracing and evaluating AI output (LangSmith, Langfuse, Azure AI evaluation tooling or equivalent)

Working knowledge
  
  

* Unix command-line tools and code repo Git
* CI/CD, DevOps tools
* Cloud infra architecture design (Azure, GCP, Oracle) and deployment using Kubernetes
* UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification

Good to have
  
  

* Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes
* Deploying AI workloads to a major cloud platform and managing cost, latency and rate limits in production
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
* Multi-agent system design, including agent-to-agent handoff and supervision patterns
* File Storage and NoSql Databases like MongoDB
* Charting libraries like HighCharts, D3.js and Recharts
* Basic wireframing skills
* Hybrid Mobile app development using React Native or Ionic

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Job Requirement**
You Bring (Experience & Qualifications)
  
  

* Bachelor's / Master's degree in computer science engineering/technology or equivalent
* Excellent communication skills

**Work Experience**

* At least 2-4 years of end-to-end web – application/tool development experience in a commercial setup specifically services or consulting organization

**Operations, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other teams**

**Zoho CRM**

**Deluge scripting**
