title: AI/ML Developer
company: Horizon17 Technology and Sustainability Pvt Ltd
description:
Horizon17 is hiring an AI/ML developer with 2–3 years of experience to build production AI modules for a document-intelligence and report-generation product.

About Horizon17

Horizon17 is a technology company. Our engineering teams build solutions across AI and machine learning, generative AI, blockchain, mobile, web, cloud and data.

We work in two ways. We build for clients, from strategy and design through engineering, launch and support. We also build and run our own in-house products, so we treat every system as owners would.

This role sits on one of those products. It reads unstructured documents and generates accurate, source-backed reports from them, with a human approving before anything is final.

What you will do

* **Report generation:**
  design and build LLM-powered generation of long-form, structured reports: sections, tables, citations and multi-format output.
* **RAG pipelines:**
  own document parsing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking and source citation, so every claim can show where it came from.
* **Agent workflows:**
  build planning, generation, regeneration and review flows in LangGraph and LangChain.
* **Document intelligence:**
  turn PDFs, scans, spreadsheets and other unstructured files into usable text and structure.
* **Classification and scoring:**
  build NLP and ML modules that classify, extract and score data points, with explainable outputs.
* **Human in the loop:**
  add conversational edits, clarification, approval, versioning and audit history, so missing or conflicting data triggers a question instead of an invented number.
* **Production APIs:**
  write Python services other product teams consume, including async jobs and streaming responses.
* **Evaluation and quality gates:**
  measure faithfulness and retrieval quality, run regression tests in CI, and monitor for hallucination and drift.
* **Module ownership:**
  take modules from design through production, write design docs, and take part in code reviews.
* **Domain translation:**
  work with product and domain experts to turn reporting rules into configuration and tests, so new document types do not need a rewrite.

What you bring

* 2-3 years of professional engineering experience in Python (3.10+), with at least 1.5 years building LLM features that run in production.
* Production LLM work with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or similar: prompting, structured output, retries, rate limits, and cost and latency trade-offs.
* Cost and token optimisation: has measured and cut LLM spend in production through prompt and context trimming, prompt caching, model routing (small model first, large model only when needed), batching, and per-feature token budgets with cost tracking.
* Hands-on RAG experience: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, reranking and retrieval evaluation.
* LangChain and LangGraph, or another agent orchestration framework, used for multi-step stateful workflows.
* Production backend skills: FastAPI or Flask, REST APIs, async Python, background jobs, and streaming over WebSockets or token streaming.
* Document AI and OCR: Azure Document Intelligence, Docling, PyMuPDF or similar.
* Measured LLM and RAG quality with RAGAS, DeepEval or equivalent, and pytest regression suites that gate releases.
* Strong data-layer skills: Pydantic, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis.
* Has built and shipped at least one AI module end to end, from design to production.
* Fine-tuning or serving open-source models.
* Clear written communication: prompts, evaluation notes and technical design docs.

Good to have

* ESG, sustainability or carbon accounting: GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3, BRSR, CDP, GRI or CSRD.
* High-stakes document products in finance, legal, healthcare or compliance reporting.
* Knowledge graphs (Neo4j or similar), or hybrid RAG and graph retrieval.
* Approval, audit and versioning workflows in an AI product.
* Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployment and monitoring of AI services.
* Classical ML where it fits: scikit-learn, XGBoost, sentence-transformers and explainability with SHAP.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior SAP GenAI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting AI-powered business solutions across McCormick's SAP landscape. This role leverages SAP Business AI, SAP AI Core, SAP AI Foundation, SAP Build Code, SAP BTP, and modern Generative AI technologies to deliver intelligent business capabilities, workflow automation, conversational experiences, and agentic AI solutions.
  
  
The position works across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other SAP applications to embed AI capabilities into business processes and business applications.
  
  
The Senior SAP GenAI Engineer provides technical expertise in agentic AI systems design and development, SAP AI innovation, and the integration of large language models (LLMs) within the SAP ecosystem. The role collaborates closely with Enterprise Architecture, Responsible AI, Product Teams, and Business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions aligned with enterprise standards and SAP Clean Core principles.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, deploy, and support Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging SAP AI Core, AI Foundation, SAP BTP, Joule, and SAP Build Code.
* Develop AI agents, orchestration workflows, and autonomous business process solutions using modern agent frameworks and SAP BTP services.
* Design and implement integrations between SAP platforms and internally provisioned enterprise AI services and approved foundation models.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions utilizing SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine, enterprise knowledge repositories, and structured business data sources.
* Build reusable AI frameworks, APIs, prompts, agent capabilities, accelerators, and development standards to enable scalable adoption of AI capabilities.
* Support solution troubleshooting, prompt optimization, performance tuning, monitoring, and continuous improvement activities for AI-enabled applications.
* Research emerging SAP AI and Agentic AI capabilities and contribute to innovation initiatives, proof-of-concepts, and pilot programs.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Responsible AI teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards.
* Participate in technical design reviews and architecture discussions.
* Contribute reusable frameworks, libraries, accelerators, and development standards.
* Support proof-of-concepts and innovation initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing across SAP development and integration teams.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, development standards, and operational runbooks.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Responsible AI, Cybersecurity, and Product teams to ensure adherence to established enterprise standards.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the Supervisor.

**Required Qualifications**
Level of Education and Discipline
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related technical discipline.
  
  
**Certification and/or Licenses**

* SAP BTP Certification
* SAP Certified Associate – SAP Generative AI Developer

**Experience - Functional/industry/commercial Knowledge, Business Acumen**

* 6-8 years of experience in SAP ERP products and enterprise application development.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience developing Generative AI, LLM-based, Agentic AI, or AI-assisted business solutions.
* Experience building applications and services on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* Experience integrating SAP applications with enterprise AI platforms and approved foundation models.
* Experience developing production-grade APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
* Experience delivering solutions using Agile product delivery methodologies.
* Understanding of SAP ERP business processes and enterprise application landscapes.

**Interpersonal Skills - Leadership, Interactions, Communication, Influence**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Effective collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Other Skills And HPO Competencies**
**Required Technical Skills**

* Experience implementing MCP architectures within SAP BTP environments.
* Strong understanding of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* Experience with SAP AI Core and SAP AI Foundation.
* Experience developing APIs, microservices, and event-driven solutions.
* Experience with SAP Integration Suite and integration patterns.
* Strong proficiency in Python development.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph
* Experience designing and implementing Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent systems.
* Experience building and deploying MCP (Model Context Protocol) agents and services.
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluations, testing frameworks, and guardrails.
* Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native development practices.
* Understanding of application security, data privacy, and Responsible AI principles.

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: Revenue Systems Administrator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and technically capable
**Revenue Systems Administrator**
to join our growing Revenue Systems team.

This is a hands-on role focused on Salesforce and Account Engagement (Pardot), with responsibility for supporting the wider revenue technology stack. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product and Technology to improve systems, automate processes, maintain data quality and ensure our teams have the tools they need to operate effectively.

You will be responsible for taking business requirements, translating them into scalable system solutions, implementing and testing changes, troubleshooting issues and supporting users across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Salesforce**

* Administer and configure Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
* Build and maintain Flows, validation rules, automations, custom fields, objects, page layouts and record types.
* Manage users, permissions, roles and access in line with our security model.
* Maintain data quality, governance and system integrity.
* Build reports and dashboards for Sales, Marketing, Operations and leadership.
* Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support releases, testing and deployment of new functionality.

**Account Engagement (Pardot)**

* Manage and develop Account Engagement (Pardot) across marketing and sales processes.
* Build automation rules, Engagement Studio programmes, segmentation lists and scoring models.
* Create and maintain forms, landing pages and email templates.
* Manage lead lifecycle processes and Salesforce synchronisation.
* Ensure accurate campaign tracking, attribution and reporting.
* Support Marketing with campaign execution and best practice.

**Revenue Technology & Automation**

* Support the wider revenue technology stack, including tools such as Slack, Zapier, Lusha and other sales and marketing platforms.
* Support integrations between Salesforce and external systems, including troubleshooting API and data synchronisation issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve system efficiency.
* Support the implementation and ongoing management of new revenue technology.
* Work with developers and technical teams on integrations and system improvements.

**Stakeholder Support & Process Improvement**

* Provide day-to-day support and training to Salesforce and revenue systems users.
* Create clear documentation, processes and training materials.
* Identify inefficient or manual processes and recommend improvements.
* Participate in sprint planning, testing and release activities.
* Take ownership of issues from initial investigation through to resolution.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience.
* Strong Salesforce Sales Cloud experience; Service Cloud experience is desirable.
* Practical experience with Account Engagement (Pardot), including automation, segmentation, Engagement Studio and campaign execution.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, automation, security and best practice.
* Experience building Salesforce Flows and automations.
* Experience managing Salesforce users, permissions and access.
* Strong understanding of CRM data quality and governance.
* Experience troubleshooting integrations and system issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change.

**Desirable**

* Salesforce Administrator Certification.
* Account Engagement Specialist certification.
* Experience with APIs, webhooks or integration platforms such as Zapier.
* HTML/CSS experience for Pardot emails and landing pages.
* Experience with Salesforce deployment and release processes.

title: Technical Artist
description:
**Unity Technical Artist**

**Location:**
New Delhi / Hybrid

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Unity Technical Artist**
who can bridge the gap between
**Art, Design and Engineering**
to help us build high-quality, performant and scalable gaming experiences.

You will work closely with
**Product Designers, Game Artists, Animators, Game Designers and Unity Engineers**
to ensure that visual assets and experiences are not only visually polished, but also technically correct, performant and production-ready.

The ideal candidate understands both the
**creative and technical sides of game development**
and enjoys solving problems around asset pipelines, rendering, shaders, animation, UI, performance and visual fidelity.

**What You'll Do**

**Art & Asset Pipeline**

* Build and maintain efficient art and asset pipelines for Unity.
* Prepare, optimize and integrate 2D and 3D assets into Unity.
* Establish technical guidelines for textures, materials, sprites, meshes, animations and VFX.
* Identify and resolve asset-related technical issues.
* Ensure assets are optimized and production-ready across target platforms.
* Help establish reusable and scalable workflows for the Art and Design teams.

**Figma → Unity**

* Work closely with Product Designers to translate
  **Figma designs into accurate Unity implementations**
  .
* Inspect Figma files to understand layouts, dimensions, spacing, typography, colors, components and assets.
* Ensure
  **pixel-accurate implementation**
  of UI and visual designs in Unity.
* Understand and work with Figma
  **components, variants, design systems and reusable patterns**
  .
* Help define efficient workflows between Figma and Unity.
* Identify visual discrepancies between designs and the final Unity implementation.
* Partner with Designers to determine the most effective technical approach for complex interactions and animations.
* Help bridge the gap between the
  **design system and Unity UI system**
  .

**Rendering & Visual Quality**

* Work with Unity's rendering pipeline to achieve the desired visual quality and performance.
* Optimize draw calls, batching, textures, shaders, materials, meshes and memory usage.
* Work with
  **URP, Shader Graph, materials, lighting and post-processing**
  .
* Create and optimize shaders and materials where required.
* Solve visual issues such as aliasing, scaling, texture quality, sorting and rendering inconsistencies.
* Maintain visual consistency across different devices and screen sizes.

**Tools & Automation**

* Develop Unity Editor tools and workflows that make designers and artists more productive.
* Automate repetitive production tasks wherever possible.
* Build tools and scripts for asset validation, importing, exporting and optimization.
* Improve the overall
  **Art → Figma → Unity → Engineering**
  production workflow.
* Establish processes that allow the team to move from concept to production faster.

**Animation & VFX**

* Support the integration and optimization of animations and VFX.
* Work with systems such as
  **Animator, Timeline, Particle Systems and Shader Graph**
  .
* Work with tools such as
  **Rive, Lottie, Spine or similar technologies**
  where appropriate.
* Ensure animations and visual effects perform consistently across target devices.

**Design ↔ Engineering Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Designers and Game Designers to translate visual concepts into production-ready Unity experiences.
* Partner with engineers to establish technically feasible visual solutions.
* Provide technical feasibility feedback during the early stages of design.
* Help designers understand Unity's technical constraints without compromising the intended experience.
* Participate in design and implementation reviews.
* Troubleshoot issues across Design, Art and Engineering.

**What We're Looking For**

* **3–8 years of experience**
  as a Technical Artist, Unity Technical Artist, Technical Designer or similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Unity**
  and its asset/rendering pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Unity UI, rendering, materials, textures, sprites, animation and VFX.
* Good knowledge of
  **C# / Unity scripting**
  for tools and workflow automation.
* Experience with
  **Shader Graph / shaders**
  .
* Strong understanding of Unity performance optimization and profiling.
* **Strong working knowledge of Figma**
  , including components, variants, design systems, layouts and reusable patterns.
* Ability to translate
  **Figma designs accurately into Unity UI**
  .
* Strong eye for
  **visual quality, pixel accuracy and interaction details**
  .
* Ability to troubleshoot visual and technical problems independently.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across
  **Design, Art, Product and Engineering**
  .
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced game development environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with
  **Figma → Unity workflows or conversion tools/plugins**
  .
* Experience with
  **Unity URP**
  .
* Experience creating custom Unity Editor tools.
* Experience with
  **Addressables / Asset Bundles**
  .
* Knowledge of mobile game optimization.
* Experience with
  **Unity Canvas architecture and UI performance**
  .
* Experience with
  **Rive, Lottie, Spine or similar animation technologies**
  .
* Familiarity with
  **Blender, Maya or other 3D tools**
  .
* Experience with design-system and token-based workflows.
* Experience with AI-assisted design or asset-generation workflows.
* Experience working on high-scale live games.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first few months, you will:

* Improve the
  **Figma → Unity → Engineering workflow**
  .
* Reduce friction between Design, Art and Engineering.
* Establish clear technical standards for Unity assets.
* Improve visual fidelity while maintaining target performance.
* Identify and solve performance bottlenecks.
* Create reusable tools that reduce repetitive designer and artist work.
* Help the team achieve
  **pixel-accurate implementation of designs in Unity**
  .
* Build scalable workflows that allow the team to ship polished experiences faster.

**Why This Role Matters**

This role will have a direct impact on how quickly and consistently we can turn
**creative concepts into polished game experiences**
.

You won't simply be implementing assets. You'll help define
**how our design and art systems work inside Unity**
, improve production workflows, and enable the team to deliver higher-quality experiences faster.

The ideal candidate is someone who can look at a beautiful Figma design and think:

**“How do we build this accurately in Unity, make it scalable, and make sure it performs?”**

**Objective Of The WHO Programme/Department**
The overall objective of the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person-centric digital health & AI solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being.
  
  
Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health & AI initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.
  
  
**Objective Of JPP**
The JPP will support the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in strengthening the responsible development, evaluation, implementation and scale-up of artificial intelligence for health ecosystem across the South-East Asia Region.
  
  
The JPP will provide specialized technical support to Member States across the AI lifecycle, including identification and prioritization of health-system problems suitable for AI applications; assessment of data readiness and technical requirements; development and review of AI approaches; validation and evaluation of AI-enabled technologies/programs; deployment and integration within health systems; and post-deployment monitoring and scale-up.
  
  
The JPP will also contribute to regional and country-level work on AI governance, safety, ethics, equity, technical standards, technology assessment, capacity building and evidence generation, helping Member States translate advances in AI into safe, effective, equitable and context-appropriate health applications.
  
  
**Supervisor**
First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH
  
  
Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD
  
  
**Terms of reference**
Under The Overall Guidance Of The Director, Department Of Health Systems Development (HSD) And The Direct Supervision Of The Regional Adviser, Digital Health, The JPP Will Provide Support In The Following Areas
  
  

* Provide technical support to WHO-SEARO and Member States on AI enabled solutions, strategies and implementation.
* Support the Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI) implementation, operationalization, developing State AI Readiness Index, and AI health work related to SAHI.
* Support the technical assessment, validation, evaluation of AI-enabled health technologies/programs.
* Support Member States in assessing AI readiness, including data availability, quality, representativeness, infrastructure, computational requirements, interoperability, workforce capacity and institutional readiness.
* Support the development and application of AI evaluation frameworks and methodologies
* Contribute to AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Support development of conceptual frameworks, technical guidance, strategic plans, policy proposals, technical specifications, reports and knowledge products related to AI in health.
* Undertake evidence reviews, technical analyses and horizon scanning on emerging AI technologies and their potential applications, risks and implications for health systems.
* Support technical implementation and integration of AI applications within existing digital health ecosystems, including consideration of interoperability, APIs, data standards, digital public infrastructure and existing health-information systems.
* Support Member States in developing technical and institutional capacity for AI in health, including technical workshops, training programmes, and practical capacity-building activities.
* Facilitate technical engagement with Ministries of Health, WHO Country Offices, academic and research institutions, technology developers, regulatory institutions, development partners and other stakeholders involved in AI development, evaluation and implementation.
* Support documentation and dissemination of AI implementation experiences, evaluations, lessons and good practices across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related technical activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with WHO-SEARO priorities.

**Education**
**Essential:**
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Computational Sciences, or another closely related technical discipline relevant to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or data science.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Masters/PhD strongly recommended in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Public Health, or a related field, with demonstrated interdisciplinary education and/or experience at the intersection of health and technology development/application.
  
  
Additional academic training, certification or demonstrated technical expertise in health law, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, health informatics, biomedical data science, AI evaluation or responsible AI would be an asset.
  
  
**Experience**
Essential: At least two years of experience working on digital health, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning projects, including direct experience in AI for health involving the development, testing, validation, deployment, evaluation, or scale-up of AI-enabled health technologies.
  
  
**Desirable**

* Experience in AI technology assessment, product development, clinical or public-health AI evaluation, AI safety, health informatics or digital health architecture.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with governments, Ministries of Health, academic and research institutions, technology developers, NGOs, development partners and/or global funders, particularly in low- and middle-income countries or the Global South.
* Relevant experience working with UN agencies, in particular WHO.
* Knowledge of any/multiple SEA Regional languages is an asset.

**Age:**
Below 35 years
  
  
This Vacancy Notice is only applicable to nationals of South-East Asia Region Member States i.e., Bangladesh, Bhutan, DPR Korea, India, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Timor-Leste
  
  
**Minimum**
**Skills required for the assignment:**

* Proficiency in spoken and written English;
* Strong technical understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and statistical modelling.
* Deep understanding on DPIs, DPI-Health, Reference Architecture
* Deep understanding of the AI development lifecycle
* Ability to critically assess and evaluate AI models and products
* Deep understanding of SAHI, National AI health strategies globally
* Understanding of health data, health information systems and the technical considerations involved in integrating AI into digital health environments.

title: Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
The
**Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System**
serves as the strategic and operational bridge between the Pharmacovigilance (PV) business/operations teams and the technical organization. This individual acts as the
**system champion, business representative, and end-to-end accountability owner**
for one or more pharmacovigilance platforms and integrated solutions — ensuring these systems meet regulatory, operational, and quality standards throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a unique blend of deep PV domain expertise, systems thinking, stakeholder management, and a forward-looking understanding of emerging technologies including AI. This person ensures those technical workstreams are effectively directed and aligned to business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Ownership and Governance
  
  

* Serve as the accountable business system owner for PV-related platforms, including safety databases, signal management tools, medical information systems, literature monitoring solutions, and reporting platforms
* Own and maintain the system roadmap, prioritizing enhancements, upgrades, and new feature rollouts in alignment with business strategy and regulatory requirements
* Lead and manage system lifecycle activities — from business requirements definition, UAT, deployment, through to retirement — ensuring timely and quality delivery of all system milestones
* Maintain and govern all business-owned system documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, SOPs, user guides, and validation plans (in close collaboration with validation/QA teams)
* Drive business sign-off and acceptance for all system changes, releases, and validation activities

Business–IT Liaison and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary point of contact for all system-related matters between PV Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and the Technical/IT organization
* Translate complex business and regulatory needs into clear, actionable technical requirements for IT developers and vendors
* Facilitate regular forums, governance meetings, and working groups to ensure alignment across business and technical stakeholders
* Manage relationships with external system vendors and platform providers, including participating in vendor performance reviews, roadmap discussions, and contract input where applicable
* Escalate risks, issues, and decisions through appropriate channels with clear business impact framing

System Champion and Change Enablement
  
  

* Serve as the internal ambassador for PV systems — promoting best practices, driving adoption, and advocating for user-centric design
* Lead change management efforts for system rollouts and upgrades, including communication planning, training coordination, and stakeholder engagement
* Represent the PV systems landscape in cross-functional forums, steering committees, and process improvement initiatives
* Champion the adoption of innovative technologies — including AI/ML-assisted capabilities — within the PV ecosystem, evaluating feasibility and business value in partnership with IT

Compliance, Quality & Regulatory Alignment
  
  

* Ensure all systems under ownership comply with applicable global regulatory frameworks, including ICH E2B(R3), EMA EVMPD, FDA requirements, and GVP modules
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure systems are maintained in a validated state in accordance with GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11
* Support and participate in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections related to PV systems
* Monitor the regulatory landscape and proactively identify impacts to systems from evolving guidance, communicating these to relevant stakeholders
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and audit trail standards are upheld across all system interactions

Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define, track, and report on system KPIs and performance metrics, driving continuous improvement initiatives based on operational data
* Identify and implement process optimizations at the intersection of business workflows and system capabilities

title: Offensive Security Developer (intern)
description:
**Apply at:**
*https://pivotsec.in/careers/*

**Why P.I.V.O.T Security?**

P.I.V.O.T Security Private Limited is a New Delhi-based offensive cybersecurity company. We think like attackers so our clients can defend like professionals. Our work spans red teaming, adversary simulation, penetration testing, digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), AI and LLM security assessment, and governance programs such as ISMS implementation. We are a product company as much as a services company. Our engineering team builds and ships our own security platforms, and our services teams use those platforms on live engagements. That loop between building and breaking shapes how we work. Our researchers have disclosed vulnerabilities to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) and presented research at international & national forums.

**About the role**

We are looking for an Offensive Security Developer Intern who writes production-quality code and wants to apply it to offensive security. You will join our product engineering team and work hands-on on STEP, our BAS platform, and WARUS, our agentic DAST and SAST platform, along with other offensive tooling as priorities evolve.

*This is a developer role first. You will design, build, test and ship software that our security teams and clients use. You will also work alongside our red team and DFIR practitioners, so you see how the tools you build perform against real environments.
﻿*

**Key Responsibilities**

* BAS platform development: Build and improve attack simulation modules, agents, orchestration logic, result collection and reporting, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK
* Agentic DAST and SAST: Develop and refine AI-driven agents that discover, test and validate vulnerabilities in web applications, APIs and source code
* New capabilities: Prototype and harden new offensive security features as the product roadmap requires
* Engineering practice: Write clean, modular, tested and documented code; follow version control discipline and take part in code reviews
* Secure development: Apply secure coding practices to everything you build. Security tooling must itself be secure
* Testing and validation: Build lab environments, write test cases and verify that features work reliably before release
* Engagement exposure: Support red team, adversary simulation and DFIR activities under supervision when assigned
* Documentation: Maintain internal technical documentation for the components you own

**Requirements**

* Strong programming ability in Python and/or Go. Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus

* Understanding of web application and API security, including the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10
* Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS) and Windows basics
* Familiarity with Docker, REST APIs and databases
* B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA or M.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related field (final-year students and recent graduates may apply)

**Good to Have**

• Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks or tool-calling workflows.

• Exposure to static analysis, dynamic scanning or fuzzing tools.

• Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, Active Directory attacks or post-exploitation concepts.

• CTF participation, responsible vulnerability disclosures or open source contributions.

• Entry-level offensive security certifications.

**What You Will Learn**

This internship is built for people who want to learn fast and go deep. You will not sit in a sandbox. You will learn on the same products and engagements our full-time team works on.

**• Product engineering:**
How a security product moves from design to release: architecture decisions, secure SDLC, code review culture, testing and release discipline.

**• Attack simulation engineering:**
How real attacker techniques are researched, modelled safely and turned into repeatable simulations mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

**• AI application security:**
How LLM agents, tool calling and orchestration work in practice, how to use AI for vulnerability discovery, and how AI systems themselves get attacked.

**• Red teaming and adversary simulation:**
How engagements are scoped, run and reported for regulated clients, through direct exposure to live work.

**• Digital forensics and incident response:**
How incidents such as ransomware attacks are triaged, investigated and contained, and what attackers leave behind.

**• Client delivery:**
How technical findings become clear, defensible reports for banks, government departments and critical-sector clients.

**• Research discipline:**
How vulnerability research and responsible disclosure work inside legal and contractual boundaries.

title: SDE-2
description:
About The Role

We're hiring Backend Engineers at the SDE-2 and SDE-3 level to help design and build the

platforms at the core of Astranova's business. You'll work across cloud-native, industry-standard

technologies — Kubernetes, gRPC, InfluxDB, Airflow, Pub/Sub and modern CI/CD — solving

real problems in IoT data processing, leasing operations, and fleet-scale system design. We're

looking for engineers who are strong on fundamentals and equally comfortable using modern

AI-assisted workflows to build faster and better.

Key Responsibilities / What You’ll Do:

• Design & Development — Architect and build scalable, high-performance backend systems that

solve real-world problems in EV leasing and fleet operations.

• System Architecture — Translate business requirements into technical designs; evaluate

trade-offs and lead engineering efforts for large-scale, distributed systems.

• IoT & Data at Scale — Build pipelines and services that ingest, process, and serve massive

volumes of IoT and telemetry data using time-series databases and modern data engineering

tools.

• AI-Native Engineering — Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your everyday

workflow, and build AI/ML-driven features directly into the product — from anomaly detection on

IoT data to LLM-powered internal tools.

• Engineering Excellence — Champion best practices — rigorous code review, clear

documentation, modular design, and strong test coverage — across the team.

• Mentorship — Guide and grow junior engineers, and help raise the technical bar across the org.

• Cross-functional Collaboration — Partner closely with product, business, and design

stakeholders across the full SDLC, from requirements to production.

Experience & Qualifications:

● Experience — 3–7 years building complex, large-scale backend or data engineering systems.

● Core Skills — Strong proficiency in Python (preferred) or Java, a solid grasp of both low-level

and high-level system design.

● Tech Stack — Hands-on experience with microservices architecture, RDBMS (e.g.,

PostgreSQL), NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB), and messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub).

● Infrastructure — Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and a major cloud platform

(GCP or AWS).

● Fundamentals — Strong grounding in data structures, algorithms, and system-design

patterns.

● Education — B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent from a reputed institute.

AI Skills We Value

We're building an engineering culture where AI tools are part of the craft, not a bolt-on. The

following are a strong plus — and if you're new to some of them, we'll help you get there.

• Agentic coding tools — Hands-on use of tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or

Windsurf for day-to-day development, refactoring, and debugging.

• LLM application development — Experience integrating LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or

similar) into backend services — function/tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming

responses.

• Prompt & context engineering — Comfort designing prompts, system instructions, and context

windows for reliable, production-grade AI behavior.

• RAG & retrieval systems — Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings,

and vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate).

• MCP / tool-use protocols — Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar

standards for connecting LLMs to external tools and data sources.

• AI workflow automation — Experience using AI agents or scripts to automate parts of the

SDLC — test generation, code review, documentation, or CI/CD tasks.

• Evaluation & guardrails — Understanding of how to evaluate AI-generated code or AI features

for correctness, security, and reliability before they ship.

For more information, visit our website at www.astranovamobility.com or reach

out to us via our LinkedIn page.

title: Middleware Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

We are hiring a Middleware Engineer to own the layer between the ad platforms and our AI: the integrations, the pipelines, the queues and the data. Our AI agents are only as good as the data under them. That data comes from Meta and Google Ads, every day, for every brand, through APIs that rate-limit, tokens that expire, webhooks that fire twice and jobs that time out. If ingestion is wrong, every insight, report and agent answer on top of it is wrong. Your job is to make it boring, correct and fast.

**The Hard Problems**

• Pull ads, creatives and metrics daily for every brand and every ad account, through APIs we do not control

• Make every job safe to run twice: no duplicates, no silent gaps

• Keep each brand's data, files and tokens fully separate, on every route and every job

• Keep one definition of ROAS, CPC, CTR and the rest, used by every screen and every agent

**Core Responsibilities**

• Platform integrations: own the Meta and Google Ads API clients (token lifecycle, rate limits, pagination, retries), built so a new platform plugs in without forking the code

• Ingestion, webhooks and jobs: own the daily ingestion pipeline, webhook intake with verification and dedup, and background jobs on Celery, Redis and SQS, with queues split so a chat request never waits behind bulk ingestion

• Data layer and metric correctness: own one MongoDB database per brand (indexes, upserts, uniqueness, migrations), Redis caching that clears when data changes, and one shared definition of every metric

• Auth and tenancy: own JWT middleware on every route, tenant checks on every read, write and file key, and secrets in a secrets store, not in code

• Ship, run and observe: own Docker, AWS ECS and GitHub Actions with tests that gate the deploy and one-step rollback, plus logs, traces and alerts so we know a brand's data is stale before they do; own high-level and low-level design for this layer

**Required Qualifications**

• 3-5 years of total experience in backend engineering; Python and FastAPI (or a similar async framework) in production

• Built and ran third-party API integrations at scale: rate limits, OAuth tokens, pagination, partial failures

• Built data pipelines or background job systems in production: Celery, SQS, Kafka or similar

• Idempotency and retries that can be explained with a real incident (the duplicate you found)

• MongoDB or another database in depth: indexes, aggregation pipelines, query plans, schema changes on live data

• Multi-tenant systems: how you kept one customer's data away from another's

• Caching with Redis or similar: when to cache, when to clear, and what went wrong

• Cloud and CI/CD: AWS (ECS, S3, SQS), Docker, GitHub Actions or equivalent

• Security basics: authn vs authz, secret handling, SSRF, injection; fixed in code, not in a checklist

• Written design docs; led at least a small team or a large project end to end

**Good to Have**

• Meta Marketing API or Google Ads API experience

• Webhook systems at volume (signature checks, replay, ordering)

• Observability (OpenTelemetry, New Relic, Sentry)

• Work next to an AI or LLM team (clean data for agents, MCP tools)

• Ad tech, martech or analytics products

**Why Join**

Every insight and every agent answer rests on the data layer you build. This is an early role in a company built from the ground up, and what you build becomes the foundation others build on.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.

title: Senior Developer
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that help our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role is responsible for designing, developing, unit testing and maintaining the Garradin wealth management / funds administration and taxation product. The Senior Developer will deliver BAU fixes and client-driven enhancements, investigate complex application and production issues, and contribute to technical design and continuous improvement while following the agreed SDLC and engineering standards.
  
  
The role works closely with Business Analysts, Technical Consultants, Test Analysts and other Developers, and reports to the Manager in India.
  
  
Garradin is a financial services product supporting funds administration and taxation for approximately 12 customers across Australia and New Zealand.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop and maintain robust, scalable solutions using Progress OpenEdge / ABL.
* Deliver BAU fixes, client enhancements and technical changes across a large, complex financial services product.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex software defects, production issues, application issues and technical environment problems.
* Analyse root causes using logs, debugging, database investigation and application/runtime diagnostics, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Work with Business Analysts and Technical Consultants to understand requirements, identify technical impacts, prepare solution designs and provide development estimates for complex enhancements.
* Design and maintain integrations and services using REST, JSON and XML, including services hosted on Progress Application Server for OpenEdge (PASOE).
* Investigate and improve database and application performance, including query optimisation, indexing, transaction/locking behaviour and efficient data access.
* Develop and maintain effective automated unit tests using ABLUnit and ensure adequate test coverage for software changes.
* Work with Test Automation and QA teams to support integration, regression and automated testing activities and to diagnose test failures.
* Participate in peer/code reviews and proactively identify defects, maintainability issues, security concerns and opportunities for refactoring.
* Follow and contribute to development, coding, branching, release and quality standards across the Garradin codebase.
* Use team engineering tools and processes effectively, including Jira, Confluence, Subversion/SVN, Jenkins, Ant and related development/quality tools.
* Contribute to CI/CD and release activities, including build troubleshooting, deployment support and investigation of environment-specific issues.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, design notes, troubleshooting information and other project documentation.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other developers and collaborate effectively with distributed teams across India and Australia.
* Contribute ideas that reduce technical debt, improve developer productivity, strengthen engineering practices and increase product quality.
* Take ownership of assigned work from analysis through implementation, testing, documentation and release, delivering within agreed estimates and timelines.
* Actively adopts and champions AI-driven development practices, including advanced coding assistants, agentic workflows, and automation opportunities across the software lifecycle.

**Unleash your potential**
.
  
  
  

* Technical
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Progress OpenEdge / ABL, preferably across OpenEdge 11.x and 12.x environments, including PDSOE.
* Practical experience using Progress Developer Studio for OpenEdge (PDSOE) for OpenEdge application development, debugging, project configuration and build/development workflows.
* Exposure to modern development environments such as Visual Studio Code and AI-assisted developer tools such as Cursor for code navigation, analysis, refactoring, documentation and developer productivity is desirable.
* Strong ABL development skills including structured programming, object-oriented concepts, error handling, reusable components and maintainable coding practices.
* Practical experience with ADM2 / legacy Progress UI technologies and understanding of existing desktop application codebases.
* Strong experience with PASOE / Progress Application Server and service-based application architecture.
* Hands-on experience developing or supporting REST services and working with JSON, XML and HTTP-based integrations.
* Strong database knowledge with practical experience in SQL/ABL queries, indexing, transaction processing, locking, data integrity and performance optimization.
* Strong debugging and production troubleshooting skills, including the ability to isolate applications, database, integration and environment-related issues.
* Experience with automated testing and unit testing frameworks, particularly ABLUnit; awareness of tools such as Test Complete is desirable.
* Experience with source control and build/release tooling such as SVN, Jenkins and Ant; familiarity with branching and release management practices.
* Experience with code-quality/static-analysis tools such as SonarLint/SonarQube is desirable.
* Experience supporting application environments involving web/application infrastructure such as Nginx and JBoss is desirable.
* Personal
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical outcomes, with the ability to take a problem from investigation through to a production-ready solution.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to root-cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical designs, risks, trade-offs and production issues clearly.
* Ability to work effectively with Business Analysts, Technical Consultants, QA/Test Automation engineers and developers.
* Ability to mentor and support other developers and contribute positively to team capability and knowledge sharing
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality, maintainability, testing and secure engineering practices.
* Adaptable and responsive, with the ability to manage competing priorities and production-critical issues in a professional manner.
* Comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders in Australia/India distributed-team environments.

**Qualification & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent technical qualification.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in Progress OpenEdge / ABL.
* Experience developing and supporting large or complex software products in a structured engineering environment.
* Experience working in medium to large development teams and collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
* Experience working with established SDLC, Agile/iterative development, code review, testing and release practices.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, funds administration, taxation or another complex transactional domain is highly desirable.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* Cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members.
  
  
The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.
  
  
This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB.
  
  
You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it.
  
  
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position expectations
  
  

* Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly
* Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems
* Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team
* Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles
* Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction
* Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release
* Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them
* Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives
* Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments
* Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems — frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search — and bring interesting developments back to the team

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
* Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable
* Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help
* Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift
* Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search
* Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time
* Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
* Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it

Nice to Have
  
  

* Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own
* Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects
* Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
* Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms
* Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns
* Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
* Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
* Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries
* Familiarity with Jira and related tools

Success measures
  
  

* In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked
* In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes
* In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works
* In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:

**Job Description**

Based in the Delhi NCR region in a hybrid work model, the Sr. AI & Application Security Specialist will be a founding member of J.S. Held’s AI & Application Security function, helping shape the strategy, standards, and security practices that enable the safe adoption of AI across the organization. This hands-on role focuses on securing AI-enabled applications, agents, RAG architectures, MCP/tool integrations, models, APIs, and cloud services. Working closely with the Senior Application Security Specialist, the successful candidate will help build and scale a modern AI security program while driving day-to-day AI security initiatives, risk management, and technical guardrails to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

**Role Details**

* Role focus: approximately 70% AI Security and 30% Application Security

**Core Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise AI Security Program. Establish AI security policies, standards, control frameworks, and security processes.

* Lead AI Security execution across standards, architecture principles, risk framework, inventory expectations, and business-aligned security requirements.

* Review AI solutions before deployment, including AI-enabled applications, agents, RAG pipelines, APIs, MCP/tool integrations, model workflows, and third-party AI services.

* Perform AI threat modeling for prompt injection, model abuse, data leakage, RAG poisoning, agent misuse, unsafe tool calls, model extraction, and AI supply-chain risk.

* Define practical controls for AI identity, delegated authorization, agent lifecycle, tool permissions, least privilege, revocation, and auditability.

* Secure agentic workflows, including agent-to-agent interactions, MCP servers, autonomous workflows, tool integrations, and SharePoint-grounded AI use cases.

* Help define runtime guardrails, including prompt/content controls, tool restrictions, behavioral monitoring, runtime enforcement, and escalation paths.

* Lead or coordinate AI security testing and red teaming for priority AI systems, agents, models, workflows, and integrations.

* Define AI logging, monitoring, detection use cases, SecOps handoffs, and AI-specific incident response procedures.

* Review model provenance, model hosting platforms, open-source models, dependencies, plugins, and third-party AI services for security and governance risk.

* Support AI governance, risk, and compliance activities, including AI policies, risk classification, inventory requirements, evidence needs, and alignment with NIST AI RMF.

* Help identify shadow AI, unmanaged agents, risky connectors, overshared knowledge sources, and other exposure paths, then drive practical remediation with owners.

* Partner with the Senior Application Security Specialist on Application Security reviews, secure SDLC, architecture reviews, code reviews, API reviews, deployment reviews, and design approvals.

* Serve as the Senior Application Security Specialist’s backup when they are out of office or when AppSec demand requires additional coverage.

* Evaluate SaaS applications for secure configuration, identity access settings, risky integrations, excessive permissions, and secure-by-design implementation.

* Review APIs for authentication, authorization, input validation, data exposure, logging, rate limiting, and secure integration patterns.

* Support software composition analysis, dependency review, secrets scanning, code scanning, vulnerability triage, remediation tracking, and risk-based vulnerability management.

* Educate developers, architects, IT, cyber teams, and business stakeholders on secure AI design, Application Security expectations, and safe AI adoption.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of cybersecurity engineering experience with meaningful Application Security experience.

* Recent hands-on experience securing generative AI, LLM-based systems, AI agents, AI-enabled SaaS, or internal AI applications.

* Strong understanding of secure application/API design, IAM, cloud security, SaaS security, software supply chain risk, and secure SDLC practices.

* Experience with vulnerability management, application security reviews, dependency risk, and practical remediation tracking.

* Ability to convert AI and Application Security risk into deployable controls, clear standards, and practical engineering guidance.

* Strong communication skills with engineering, IT, cyber, GRC, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot administration, Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.

* Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, model hosting, LLM gateways, MCP, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows.

* Experience with AI red teaming, AI posture management, runtime guardrails, model security, AI observability, or shadow AI discovery.

* Familiarity with AppSec tooling and practices such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, API testing, code review, and dependency governance.

* Scripting or automation experience such as Python or PowerShell

**Required Skills**

* AI threat modeling

* RAG security

* Agent security

* MCP security

* AI identity and delegated authorization

* AI security frameworks

* Application Security reviews

* API security

* Secure SaaS configuration review

* Secure SDLC and architecture review

* Software composition analysis and dependency risk review

* Vulnerability management and remediation tracking

* Cloud security, Azure preferred

* Governance, including NIST AI RMF

**Job Overview:**
The JDE Technical Specialist designs, develops, supports and improves technical solutions within JD Edwards EnterpriseOne. The role delivers reliable applications, reports, batch processes, integrations, orchestrations and data solutions while protecting production stability, security and auditability. Working closely with JDE functional consultants, business teams, CNC administrators, database specialists and external partners, the specialist converts functional requirements into maintainable technical solutions and provides advanced production support.

title: Formal Verification Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced Formal Verification Engineer with strong CPU/GPU and verification fundamentals to work in NVIDIA's Central Formal team based in Bangalore. NVIDIA builds CPUs and GPUs that powering up the next generation AI and HPC workloads. This position will have you crafting and optimising formal verification flows across CPU/GPU projects and resolving tool issues for design teams with tool vendors. Additionally, you'll verify the micro-architecture using formal verification tools to employ the latest model checking and equivalence checking techniques. You will be expected to understand the design & implementation, define the verification scope, and ensure design correctness. You will use advanced formal techniques to obtain full proofs, or sufficient bounded proofs, of the design while working with architects, designers, pre- and post-silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* The specification, implementation, and maintenance of an integrated end-to-end formal verification flow for the formal verification team.
* Developing scripts to automate the verification process.
* Review formal setups and proofs with design and verification teams.
* Maintain and extend assertion libraries, including support for both simulation and FV.
* Identifying key behaviours for verification of DUT and creating a verification plan.
* Developing verification environment including environment assumptions, assertions and cover properties in context of the verification plan.
* Applying various FV techniques to prove correctness of digital designs.
* Debugging RTL to identify causes of failure scenarios.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelors/Masters in Electronics & Communications or Computer Science or electrical engineering from a reputed engineering college.
* Minimum 2+ years of industry experience on formal techniques for verification.
* Strong analytical skills to tackle hard problems.
* Excellent command of scripting.
* Strong knowledge of architectures of CPU designs and digital logic.
* Good understanding of abstraction techniques for effective verification.
* Hands-on experience with HDLs such as Verilog / System Verilog.
* Understanding of temporal logic assertions.
* Preferable experience with a variety of Formal Verification Tools
* Strong communication skills are required along with the ability to work in a dynamic product oriented team and collaborate effectively across sites.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Worked on various pieces of CPU/GPU unit/microarchitecture verification
* Background with complex verification projects that had used formal techniques for closure.
* Experience of collaborating with geographically diverse cross-functional teams
* A history of mentoring junior engineers and interns a huge plus.
