title: Engineer, TSG Data Engineering
description:
**Company Profile**
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.
  
  
**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**
A Data Engineer is someone with a proven track record of delivering application modules with minimal to no supervision from senior engineering team members. Additionally, the individual is also responsible of providing guidance to associate/ entry level engineers in the team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Technical Delivery (80%)**

* Work with teams developing and updating enterprise applications.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Demonstrate ability to identify all technical steps required to complete a story. Work with the senior team members to evaluate product backlog items and functional specifications and determine the appropriate approach to developing the required functionality in the software application.
* Demonstrate high-level business and domain knowledge and ability to understand and achieve business outcomes.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories and perform task breakdown and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule.
* Demonstrate good understanding of using the underlying infrastructure to develop his/her features.
* Follow the standard application design and architecture to develop his/her features and work with senior team members to ensure non-functional metrics (e.g. scalability, performance) are met.
* Prepare work estimates for committed tasks and components with support from senior team members.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion.
* Participate in the testing and implementation of applications releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/ load testing etc. through internal/ external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.
* Follow Bain development project process and standards in completing committed tasks and modules and contribute to the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* With guidance, write technical documentation as required.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Contribute to the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Help in the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.

**Communication (10%)**

* Ability to present the technical findings and recommendations to the Software Development team.
* Clearly communicates impediments to completing a story and ensures clear understanding of definition of ‘done’.
* Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.

**About You**

* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions,
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills

**Data Engineering - Technical Skills**

* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory

* DevOps: Azure DevOps, Git, GitHub Actions

**Experience**

* 2-4+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/ contingencies

**Education OR Equivalent Combination Of Education, Training, And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Company Description**

Nikah Forever is India’s leading community matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages convenient and meaningful for the Muslim community. With
**over 5 Million+ members**

, we are redefining how people connect and build lifelong relationships through trust, technology, and cultural understanding.

Our mission is to simplify the marriage journey while fostering genuine connections rooted in shared values and traditions.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**SDET with strong coding fundamentals, practical AI skills, and a creative problem-solving mindset**
. You should enjoy exploring how systems work, finding unexpected ways they can fail, and writing code to test them. Your work will go beyond the UI—covering
**mobile, web, APIs, backend services, databases, and third-party integrations**
.

We value a mindsets like : question assumptions, investigate unusual behaviour, think beyond predefined test cases, and turn repetitive work into automation. Freshers with strong projects, internships, or demonstrated practical skills are welcome. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams, taking increasing ownership as you learn the platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Automation & Engineering**

* Build and maintain automated tests for critical web, mobile, and API workflows.
* Write reusable test utilities, assertions, and scripts using
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java**
  .
* Use frameworks such as
  **Playwright, Appium, Selenium, or equivalent tools**
  , depending on the application.
* Create reliable test data and investigate failing or flaky tests.
* Contribute to running automated tests through CI/CD pipelines.

**Functional & Exploratory Testing**

* Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, boundary, negative, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate journeys across onboarding, profiles, search, chat, notifications, subscriptions, and payments.
* Think beyond the happy path: test interrupted journeys, repeated actions, unexpected inputs, and changing network conditions.
* Verify features against requirements and help identify missing acceptance criteria.

**API, Backend & Database Validation**

* Test APIs using
  **Postman and code-based automated tests**
  .
* Validate payloads, status codes, authentication, business rules, and error handling.
* Use
  **SQL**
  to verify records, state transitions, and consistency across UI, API, and database.
* Read application/server logs and trace issues across
  **UI → API → backend → database**
  .
* Validate integrations with payment gateways, OTP/SMS/WhatsApp services, and notifications.

**Mobile & Payment Flows**

* Test Android and iOS apps, including applications built with
  **Flutter**
  .
* Validate permissions, deep links, push notifications, app lifecycle, and network-related behaviour.
* Test checkout, subscriptions, trials, offers, and payment success, failure, cancellation, retry, and timeout scenarios.
* Check that transaction states remain consistent across the application and backend.

**AI-Assisted Testing & Problem Solving**

* Use AI coding assistants and LLMs to support test design, automation, debugging, and defect investigation.
* Provide relevant requirements, code, logs, and API details to get useful AI output.
* Review and validate generated code and test cases for correctness, coverage, and maintainability.
* Build small scripts or tools that improve testing speed and reduce repetitive effort.
* Exercise judgment when sharing application data with AI tools.

**Defect Investigation & Release Quality**

* Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, and supporting evidence.
* Work with developers to isolate issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Verify fixes, run regression checks, and support release smoke testing and post-release validation.

**Required Skills**

* **0–1 year of experience**
  in testing, development, or automation; relevant projects and internships count.
* Ability to write and debug code in
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java**
  .
* Practical exposure to at least one test automation framework.
* Understanding of testing fundamentals, SDLC, and the defect life cycle.
* Working knowledge of
  **HTTP, REST APIs, Postman, and SQL**
  .
* Ability to use logs and other evidence to investigate issues systematically.
* Practical experience using
  **AI tools for engineering tasks**
  , with the ability to explain and verify their output.
* Clear written communication and structured bug reporting.
* Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn.

**Nice to Have**

* Projects involving mobile automation, Flutter testing, or API test suites.
* Familiarity with
  **Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools**
  .
* Exposure to payment gateways, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Basic understanding of performance testing, concurrency, and security testing.
* Personal tools, GitHub contributions, or examples of bugs you discovered independently.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

Someone who asks

title: Controls & Electronics Engineer, Industrial Automation and Defect Detection
description:
**Controls & Electronics Engineer, Industrial Automation and Defect Detection**

Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division- Nits Engineering & Designing Alley

**Location:**

New Delhi, India

**Type:**

Full time

**About the Division**

NITS Engineering's Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division builds the machine vision, controls, and automation systems that power precision manufacturing across the company's product lines, from biofabrication system to a growing range of automated defect detection systems. The division works at the intersection of industrial electronics, PLC based control, and machine vision, developing systems that catch defects, drive quality decisions, and keep manufacturing lines running reliably. As the division scales, it is expanding its automation, controls, and computer vision capability to support new product lines and manufacturing processes across NITS Engineering.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Controls & Electronics Engineer to join the division and lead the PLC development of industrial automation and defect detection systems, starting with our existing bottle cap defect detection and extending to other advanced engineering platforms as the division's scope grows. The role also supports broader automation systems work as needed.

The role spans PLC based machine control, motion systems, sensors, actuators, machine vision, industrial electronics, temperature control, and fluidic systems, with a particular focus on building automated defect detection capability into our platforms. You will work across the complete system, from selecting and integrating components and developing control and vision based inspection logic, to wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the machine.

**What You Will Do**

*Defect Detection and Machine Vision (Computer Vision Division)*

* Develop and integrate machine vision based defect detection systems, including cameras, lighting, triggering, image acquisition, and inspection logic.
* Define detection criteria and inspection routines for bioprinting and biofabrication processes, working closely with process and biomedical engineering teams.
* Integrate machine vision output with PLC control logic to enable automated pass or fail decisions, alarms, and corrective actions.
* Continuously refine detection accuracy and reliability as new failure modes are identified.

*Industrial Automation and Controls*

* Develop PLC based control systems using platforms such as Siemens S7-1200 and TIA Portal.
* Design and implement machine control logic, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and HMI interfaces.
* Integrate stepper and servo motors, motor drivers, encoders, limit switches, sensors, heaters, valves, pumps, and other actuators.
* Develop electrical architectures for 3D bioprinters, including power distribution, control panels, SMPS, relays, protection, wiring, connectors, and machine I/O.
* Integrate temperature control systems including heaters, RTDs, thermocouples, and temperature controllers.
* Integrate pressure, flow, position, optical, and other sensors used in dispensing and fluidic systems.
* Implement industrial communication and networking between PLCs, drives, sensors, cameras, embedded controllers, and industrial PCs.

*Electrical Build and Support*

* Build, wire, test, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic assemblies and control panels.
* Diagnose electrical noise, grounding, signal integrity, communication, timing, and control system issues.
* Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, BOMs, and technical documentation.
* Commission machines and work with mechanical, software, and fluidics engineers during system integration and testing.

*Biofabrication Systems Support*

* Contribute automation and controls expertise to broader biofabrication platform development as projects require.
* Collaborate with the biofabrication and biomedical engineering teams on process automation, sensing, and system reliability.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in industrial automation, machine controls, electronics integration, robotics, or hardware development.
* Practical experience with PLC programming and industrial control systems.
* Exposure to machine vision or computer vision based inspection systems, or strong interest in developing this capability.
* Ability to design and troubleshoot electrical circuits, control panels, and machine wiring.
* Strong understanding of sensors, relays, solenoids, motor drivers, actuators, power supplies, and industrial I/O.
* Experience with stepper or servo motion systems and machine level motion control.
* Ability to read and create electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Hands on experience using multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and other electrical test equipment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose problems across electrical, electronic, mechanical, and software interfaces.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Siemens S7-1200, TIA Portal, HMI, and PROFINET.
* Experience with industrial machine vision, cameras, lighting, triggering, and image acquisition, or basic computer vision or image processing tools.
* Experience with pneumatic systems, solenoid valves, pumps, pressure control, or fluidic systems.
* Experience with temperature control systems and PID control.
* Familiarity with Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, CAN, RS-485, or other industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with Raspberry Pi, STM32, ESP32, or other embedded platforms.
* Basic PCB design or electronics prototyping experience.
* Experience integrating electronics, controls, or vision systems into 3D printers, robotics, laboratory equipment, or other precision machines.
* Basic Python or C/C++ for hardware interfacing, testing, or vision pipeline development.

**Why Join**

* Help build and shape the Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division from an early stage, with direct ownership of our defect detection systems.
* Work directly on the electrical, control, and vision architecture of advanced 3D bioprinters and biomedical systems.
* Own control, electronics, and inspection subsystems from component selection through integration, commissioning, and testing.
* Gain exposure to biofabrication systems and processes alongside core automation work.
* Access to in house prototyping, fabrication, electronics, and testing facilities.
* Work closely with mechanical, fluidics, software, and biomedical engineering teams.
* A fast moving engineering environment with substantial technical responsibility and room to grow.

**How to Apply**

Applicants who do not fully meet every point above but demonstrate strong potential and relevant hands on experience are encouraged to apply. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Our pre-selection process is conducted by our recruiters directly, not by artificial intelligence.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for next steps. Applications sent directly to the email address will not be accepted or entertained.

To apply, please fill out the application form and include links to any past projects, prototypes, control systems, or vision and inspection systems demonstrating your automation, electronics, or computer vision experience.

description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. * Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.

title: Sr. Symfony Engineer  - PHP (Remote, Full-Time) [AR024]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity — it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer, you will take hands-on ownership of backend development within a mature Symfony platform that manages marketing and revenue data for enterprise customers. The core application currently runs on Symfony 6.1, with an upgrade to Symfony 7 planned, alongside an Angular front end and TypeScript and Python AI agent microservices.

  

This is a strongly backend-weighted, senior hands-on engineering role requiring an architect mindset, strong independence and the ability to understand how technical decisions affect the wider system. You will work within a remote, cross-functional product squad alongside engineering, product, QA and DevOps colleagues.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Take ownership of backend development within the core Symfony application, becoming fully independent in delivering work within 2–3 months of joining
  
* Review and critically assess code written by the team and AI tools, challenging proposed approaches and making sure key considerations have been properly addressed
  
* Support the migration from Symfony 6.1 to Symfony 7 by resolving versioning, compatibility and legacy issues currently preventing the upgrade
  
* Improve the application’s performance, scalability and maintainability, making it easier and safer to introduce new functionality
  
* Work across the Angular front end, TypeScript and Python-based AI agent services, collaborating with DevOps where backend changes impact other areas of the system
  
* Be comfortable reading and understanding the Angular/TypeScript codebase, even though the role is primarily backend focused. Strong front-end development experience is not required
  
* Understand the wider impact of technical decisions across Symfony, Angular and AI services, while spotting gaps or issues in both human-written and AI-generated code
  
* Question existing approaches, identify root causes and look for better ways of building things rather than simply completing assigned tickets
  
* Deliver thoughtful, maintainable solutions within a legacy codebase while maintaining a consistent pace of delivery
  
* Work with a high level of autonomy and ownership while collaborating effectively with a remote, cross-functional team
  
* Follow SOC 2, PII and security requirements consistently and without exception
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 8+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including at least 5 years working with PHP
  
* 7+ years of Expert-level PHP development experience
  
* 3+ years of recent commercial experience with Symfony 6.x/7 at Advanced level. Strong senior-level Laravel experience may be considered where the experience is clearly transferable and the candidate has a good understanding of the differences between Laravel and Symfony
  
* 4+ years of Advanced experience in backend architecture, system design and scalability
  
* 2+ years of Advanced experience using AI development tools critically, including reviewing, validating and challenging AI-generated code rather than accepting it without question
  
* 5+ years of Advanced MySQL experience, including database schema design and query optimisation. Equivalent depth of experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database may also be considered
  
* At least 1 year of experience working with or understanding Angular/TypeScript. Experience with React or Vue using TypeScript may also be considered, but some front-end exposure is essential
  
* 3+ years of Advanced experience with automated testing using PHPUnit. Experience with Pest or another equivalent PHP testing framework may also be considered
  
* At least 1 year of Intermediate experience working on framework upgrades and modernising legacy codebases. Experience with major-version upgrades or significant refactoring in other large PHP applications may be considered
  
* 2+ years of Intermediate AWS experience. Equivalent experience with Azure or GCP may also be considered
  
* Fluent written and spoken English
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  
* Ability to work UK hours
  
* Ability to successfully complete strict background checks and adhere to PII and data protection requirements
  
* Strong self-sufficiency, with the ability to operate independently and without handholding after 2–3 months, while continuing to collaborate effectively with the wider team
  
* A hands-on engineering approach combined with an architectural mindset, with the ability to understand how and why the wider system works rather than focusing only on writing code
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* 2+ years of Intermediate CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions; GitLab CI, Jenkins or Azure DevOps are suitable alternatives
  
* Basic experience with Amazon Redshift or data warehousing; Snowflake or BigQuery may be considered.
  
* Azure exposure alongside AWS
  
* Previous project leadership experience
  
* Previous mentoring and technical leadership experience with other engineers

title: Applied AI Sr Associate Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* 3–5 years of hands-on full-stack engineering experience with a track record of independently delivering production-quality applications end to end; proficiency in React 18 with TypeScript (component architecture, hooks, state management with Zustand or Redux, and React Router for complex multi-view portals), Node.js/Express for BFF APIs (including authentication flows, request proxying, caching, and structured error handling), and Python/FastAPI for backend microservices and data processing pipelines.
* Solid understanding of SQL, PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and workflow state persistence) and Redis (caching, session management, and task queue brokering via Celery or equivalent); proficiency with Docker for containerizing Node.js and Python services with identical dev/prod environments; ability to build and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines covering lint, unit test, build, and zero-downtime deploy on merge.
* Experience integrating with Salesforce REST APIs and SOQL — reading Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History at volume — is preferred; familiarity with Salesforce Connected App setup, OAuth 2.0 flows, and per-user token management; experience triggering write-backs via Flows or Apex REST endpoints with validation gates and audit logging; exposure to Salesforce Platform Events or Pub/Sub API for real-time case state change handling is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM models into production applications — prompt engineering, context management, structured output parsing, and cost control; familiarity with LangChain (Python) or equivalent orchestration frameworks for chaining LLM calls, managing memory, and enforcing guardrails; understanding of embedding-based semantic search (text-embedding-ada-002 or similar) for similarity scoring and duplicate detection; commitment to human-in-the-loop design — AI assists and drafts; humans review and commit — enforced at the API layer, not just the UI.
* Proficiency with Pandas and openpyxl for Excel-in/Excel-out data processing pipelines; experience with fuzzy matching libraries (RapidFuzz or similar) for entity deduplication and overlap analysis; exposure to graph traversal (NetworkX or equivalent) for ownership hierarchy and relation analysis; ability to integrate with external data APIs.
* Strong grasp of REST API design principles including versioning, error contracts, pagination, and backward compatibility; ability to write well-structured, tested code — unit tests, integration tests, and API contract tests as part of the development workflow, not an afterthought; experience maintaining an append-only audit log tied to business entity IDs for compliance and traceability; comfortable self-managing across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure layers in a high-autonomy environment within a 2-week sprint cadence.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Responsibilities**

* Build an end-to-end AI-assisted operations platform that replaces manual Salesforce workflows and spreadsheet-based processes with an auditable, intelligent console. Implement the full AI-driven platform architecture across multiple production phases; build the React 18 + TypeScript portal spanning all stakeholder views; engineer the FastAPI Python workflow service with async Excel-in/Excel-out processing, Celery task queuing, and status polling.
* Provision and maintain the Salesforce Connected App; manage the OAuth token lifecycle; implement read operations across Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History; build validated Salesforce write-back flows (merge, email update, segment patch) with AI pre-flight checks and analyst confirmation gates before any SFDC commit; implement real-time case state monitoring via Salesforce Platform Events to drive escalation detection.
* Integrate case summarization, duplicate analysis, action pre-flight checks, and an AI chat assistant pre-seeded with live case context; implement the escalation prediction engine; enforce human-in-the-loop guardrails at the API layer.
* Manage phased delivery with defined go-live milestones; lead UAT sessions with analysts, managers, and leadership at each phase go-live, and incorporate feedback into the subsequent sprint backlog; maintain Azure infrastructure, monitor application health, and own incident response throughout the build period.
* Document architecture decisions, API contracts, data schemas, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability beyond the build phase.

**About The Team**
Our Data Management & Analytics team within COR OU is responsible for maintaining Account and Contact information with CRM, we are currently looking at transformation towards AI-assisted operations platform that converts manual Salesforce workflows, spreadsheet-based verification, and ad-hoc bulk data processes into a structured, auditable, and intelligent console.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Description**
Articore runs Redbubble, TeePublic, Dashery, and Frankly Wearing — some of the largest creator marketplaces in the world, with Redbubble's catalog alone exceeding 40 billion SKUs.
  
  
The Search & Content team owns search, discovery, and content quality across Redbubble and TeePublic — driving relevance, ranking, and personalisation across a catalog of 40 billion+ SKUs. With organic traffic and SEO central to how the company grows, this team is one of the highest-leverage groups in engineering: improvements here move the needle on acquisition, conversion, and the long-term defensibility of our content position.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll be a hands-on technical anchor for the domain — owning meaningful pieces of our search and ranking infrastructure end-to-end, and helping raise the technical bar for a team that's still building out its depth. You'll work alongside a small group of engineers and data scientists spread across Australia, the US, and a growing India presence, partnering closely with the team's engineering manager, tech lead, and product manager to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, well-reasoned solutions.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Feature development and platform integration: Design, code, test, and deploy software across the team's systems. Lead small to medium-sized initiatives that solve complex problems at scale, in line with Articore’s Engineering Principles and architecture standards.
  
  
BAU maintenance and system health: Maintain and uplift existing services, manage tech debt responsibly, and ensure systems are well monitored with up-to-date documentation, under the guidance of the Tech Lead.
  
  
Delivery collaboration and technical leadership: Participate in discussions on technical approach and feasibility, collaborate with team leads on discovery and scoping, translate business requirements into technical spikes and deliverables, and participate in team ceremonies including standups, planning, retrospectives, and showcases.
  
  
Coaching and people development: Coach and support less experienced engineers in technical development, good engineering practices, and Articore values.
  
  
Innovation and roadmap input: Learn new tools, techniques, and technologies to shape opportunities for the business, and provide input into the team's technology roadmap to enable sustainable delivery against company objectives.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience with search infrastructure (e.g. OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr, or vector/AI search)
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining retrieval pipelines and evaluating retrieval quality, including offline metrics and A/B guardrails
* Strong understanding of information retrieval fundamentals: lexical retrieval, semantic and vector search, hybrid retrieval, and relevance tuning at scale
* Familiarity with SEO engineering, content quality systems, or personalisation and recommendations at scale
* Experience applying NLP or embedding-based models to query understanding, intent classification, or query expansion.
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and analytics instrumentation (e.g. Amplitude, RudderStack) in a product experimentation context
* Experience working with microservices and/or monolith architectures. The team owns a mix of standalone services and a monolith, and is actively migrating components between them, so comfort operating across both patterns is valuable.
* Experience using AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow, and curiosity about applying it more deeply.

**Key Attributes for Success**
Demonstrated effectiveness operating in a global company, with the communication, discipline, and async judgment required to keep work moving across time zones.
  
  
Curiosity and willingness to explore - the team owns a broad surface area of services across two marketplaces. The right person is energised by digging into systems they haven't seen before rather than deterred by it.
  
  
Ability to work independently on features end-to-end with the team's support, from technical spike and scoping through to deployment.
  
  
Solid testing and code quality practices, with the ability to uphold engineering standards and contribute to documentation and system health under the guidance of the Tech Lead.
  
  
Collaborative and inclusive — engages well across disciplines, gives and receives feedback openly, pairs willingly, and takes real interest in helping less experienced engineers grow.

title: Principal, Tech (Middleware)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm’s offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade-offs.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming

Build practical AI solutions that make work easier across Global Sales and Marketing. As a Low-Code AI Developer, you will test and deploy governed AI agents, workflows and applications using Microsoft Power Platform and the Microsoft AI stack. * Rapidly prototype, iterate and deploy production-light AI applications, agents, bots, workflows and data integrations using approved low-code tools.

* Follow Rockwell Automation requirements for responsible AI, data classification, privacy, security, architecture, accessibility, application lifecycle management and production deployment.
* Support deployment, monitoring, maintenance and controlled enhancement of released solutions, including observability of platform usage and capacity usage where available.
* Reuse approved enterprise capabilities and patterns before creating new solutions, and escalate integration, data-access or security needs through the appropriate governance path.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related technology field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 2+ years of experience configuring connectors, APIs, authentication and data integrations in an enterprise environment.
* Working knowledge of prompt design, AI grounding, RAG concepts and responsible use of generative AI.
* Experience testing, troubleshooting, documenting and supporting solutions through development and release.
* 2+ years of experience working within governed enterprise environments and following security, privacy, data and deployment standards.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* Experience with Microsoft AI Builder, Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI capabilities, Prompt Flow, Dataverse or Power Platform application lifecycle management.
* Experience connecting AI or automation solutions to SharePoint, SQL, OneLake, CRM, ERP or other enterprise data sources.
* Experience applying RAG, structured prompting, evaluation techniques and human-in-the-loop controls to improve output quality and reliability.
* Experience designing reusable components, templates and governed solution patterns rather than one-off automations.
* Familiarity with source control, solution packaging, environment strategy, release management and production support practices.
* Exposure to sales, marketing, customer experience, customer support or revenue-enablement processes.
* Experience preparing technical demos and concise documentation for cross-functional use-case teams.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure AI or related technologies.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:

 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. **How You Will Contribute**
* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end\-to\-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject\-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive\-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model\-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower\-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client\-facing systems.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands\-on experience building production\-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model\-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade\-offs, and working with self\-hosted or open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client\-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non\-technical subject\-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands\-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi\-step agents, including tool\-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace\-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights \& Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

 Based in India, the Associate Manager, Integrated Modeling Solutions will develop, test, enhance, and deliver components of Prudential's proprietary PyVal liability engine and Eureka! integrated modeling application. This hands\-on role brings together modern software development with actuarial, finance, investment, and risk expertise to support valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, and strategic decision\-making across multiple businesses and jurisdictions.

description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
   

  

 Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
   

  

**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
 While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1\.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
   

  

 At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high\-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Based in India, the Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions will lead the team responsible for the architecture, design, development, testing, governance, and delivery of Prudential's strategic PyVal and Eureka! modeling platforms. This role combines deep financial or actuarial modeling expertise with modern software engineering, people leadership, and disciplined execution to advance an integrated global modeling ecosystem supporting valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, reinsurance analysis, and strategic decision\-making.
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
* Set the technical direction and actionable roadmap for assigned PyVal and Eureka! capabilities, and lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and controlled deployment of scalable Python\-based modeling solutions.
* Translate global priorities into a sequenced portfolio of model development, enhancement, and remediation work, managing scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, releases, and delivery commitments across concurrent initiatives.
* Maintain rigorous model governance and controls across model logic, assumptions, data lineage, documentation, testing, access, release management, validation, and production support.
* Lead, coach, and build a high\-performing India\-based modeling team, strengthening capability across actuarial and financial modeling, Python engineering, insurance products, governance, and stakeholder management.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Finance, Actuarial, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, clearly communicating model insights, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations.


**What You Will Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Fellowship credential from the Society of Actuaries, Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, Institute of Actuaries of India, or an equivalent recognized actuarial body.
* Ten or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative risk, insurance finance, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated people leadership and experience leading complex model development, transformation, or platform modernization initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Advanced Python expertise, strong knowledge of modern software development practices for controlled financial or actuarial models, and strong executive communication and decision\-making skills.


**What will set you apart?**
* Deep experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement, reinsurance, institutional products, or related insurance businesses.
* Experience with valuation, forecasting, asset liability management, capital planning, liquidity risk, stress testing, or strategic asset allocation.
* Knowledge of US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or comparable insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems.
* Experience with cloud\-enabled platforms, Git\-based development, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment, data architecture, or Agile portfolio delivery.
* Experience building or expanding a modeling, analytics, actuarial, or finance capability within a global capability center.
* \*PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**About Bain AI, Insights \& Solutions (AIS)**
 Bain’s AI, Insights \& Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI\-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Have**
 Bain works with clients on board\-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step\-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are hiring an AI Engineer to build GenAI and agentic AI applications for enterprise use cases, ranging from rapid proofs of concept (POCs) to MVPs and, where appropriate, scaled production deployments. You will design and implement LLM\-driven applications and agentic workflows that use tools, data, and enterprise systems to execute multi\-step tasks reliably and safely. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.
   

  

 While GenAI and agentic AI are the primary focus, you will also draw on data science and ML engineering skills as needed, including building evaluation approaches, working with data pipelines, and developing or integrating ML models when they materially improve performance or reliability.
   

  

 You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
   

  

 Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI applications that drive real business outcomes**
* Design and develop GenAI applications (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, decision support) using modern LLM stacks.
* Implement agentic workflows where they add clear value (e.g., tool use, multi\-step execution, human\-in\-the\-loop controls), with attention to reliability, safety, and clear failure modes.
* Design and build advanced search, retrieval, and knowledge pipelines across diverse data structures and stores (e.g., hybrid search, vector stores, graph databases/knowledge graphs, and traditional data platforms), covering indexing strategies, metadata design, relevance tuning/reranking, freshness, caching, access controls, and source attribution.
* Build robust agent capabilities including context engineering, memory/state management (short\-term and long\-term), orchestration, routing, and tool integration patterns.
* Integrate solutions into enterprise environments and workflows (APIs, data systems, collaboration tools), balancing quality, latency, cost, privacy, and adoption.
* Translate ambiguous client needs into clear technical requirements, tradeoffs, and delivery plans.


**Build And Apply Data Science And Machine Learning Capabilities**
* Build ML solutions end\-to\-end: data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation/testing, and performance analysis.
* Apply the right methods for the problem, spanning classical ML and deep learning (including sequence, text, and image models when relevant).
* Create reproducible training and evaluation pipelines (versioning, experiment tracking, robust validation, clear documentation).
* Demonstrate fluency with modern deep learning concepts, including transformer fundamentals and LLM pre\-training vs post\-training concepts (e.g., instruction tuning and preference optimization approaches).


**Engineer for real delivery: POC → MVP → production**
* Write clean, testable, maintainable code and ship AI services through the full SDLC: build → test → deploy → monitor → iterate.
* Implement MLOps and GenAIOps practices: CI/CD, reproducibility, environment parity, model/prompt/agent versioning, and operational readiness.
* Build evaluation and observability for GenAI and agentic systems: tracing and instrumentation, regression test suites, automated scoring where appropriate, and iteration loops for prompt/policy optimization.
* Design for secure enterprise deployment: access controls, auditability, data handling for sensitive/PII data, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Build reusable components and accelerators (templates, evaluation harnesses, connectors, orchestration patterns) that scale across client contexts.


**Thrive in a client\-facing consulting environment**
* Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation.
* Work effectively with Bain consultants to prioritize the critical few technical decisions that unlock business value.
* Support proposal shaping and scoping: effort sizing, architecture options, risk assessment, and delivery roadmaps.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Core engineering \+ AI application skills
+ 3–5\+ years of professional AI / ML engineering experience (or equivalent), with strong backend engineering fundamentals.
+ Strong proficiency in Python and experience building APIs/services (e.g., REST/gRPC) and integrating with enterprise systems.
+ Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications with delivery considerations (latency, cost, reliability, security).
+ Experience building advanced retrieval/search systems (e.g., hybrid retrieval, vector search, reranking), and comfort working across multiple data stores (vector, graph, relational/document/search).
+ Experience implementing agentic patterns (context management, tool integration, orchestration, and memory/state handling) and strong judgment about when agentic approaches are (and are not) appropriate.
+ Strong engineering practices: testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, and performance profiling.

* Cloud, platform, and production delivery experience
+ Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure (environment management, reliability, observability, scaling).
+ Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (or equivalent orchestration) and operating services in production (debugging, performance, resilience).
+ Proven ability to implement security, privacy, and governance requirements for AI systems (authentication/authorization, access controls, PII/sensitive data handling, enterprise risk controls).

* Breadth of knowledge across data science and machine learning
+ Experience training, validating, and testing ML models; strong understanding of overfitting, generalization, and evaluation methodology.
+ Practical experience with feature engineering and data preprocessing for real\-world datasets.
+ Familiarity with a broad set of ML algorithms (classical ML and deep learning), and the ability to choose methods that match the business and data constraints.
+ Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tooling (e.g., experiment tracking, model registry, feature store concepts).

* Delivery mindset and consulting skills
+ Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and complexity, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes independently or with a collaborative team.
+ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and results to mixed audiences.
+ Strong stakeholder management skills; comfort working directly with clients.

* Working Model \& Travel
+ This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
+ Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Chariot** 




 Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundational AI models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll own products and systems across Chariot, from deciding what to build for users to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it. That includes full\-stack product development, data and evaluation pipelines, and the backend infrastructure that serves our models at scale.
 



 You'll work directly with users and researchers to understand problems, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for the result.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



1. **Products, end to end.** 
 Understand user needs, decide which problems to solve, and build across the frontend and backend. Scope work into useful increments, launch, and improve based on what you learn.
2. **Measurement.** 
 Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand whether users are getting value. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to guide what you build next.
3. **Backend and inference systems.** 
 Design and operate services that serve our models reliably at scale. Own APIs, queues, storage, and GPU\-backed inference workloads, with close attention to latency, throughput, cost, and reliability.
4. **Data pipelines.** 
 Build and own systems that collect, clean, filter, deduplicate, and prepare large volumes of text and audio for training and evaluation.
5. **Evaluation.** 
 Work with researchers to turn test sets and error patterns into automated, repeatable evaluations that measure model quality and catch regressions.



  





**What we look for** 



* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.** 
 You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Strong product sense.** 
 You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Full\-stack engineering ability.** 
 You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.** 
 You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can debug beyond the surface.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.** 
 AI\-enabled workflows are part of how you build. You know how to give tools useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.** 
 You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability, and change course when something isn't working.



  





 Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large\-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems (ASR or TTS), or multilingual products is a strong plus.
 



  





**How to apply** 



* Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you. Tell us about something you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned after launch.

 About the Job
   

  





 As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities:
   

  




* Design and implement high\-performance, fault\-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission\-critical business workflows 24x7x365\.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud\-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi\-tenant SaaS environments.

* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.



 About You
   

  





 You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.
   

  





  

  

 You will be successful in this role if you:
   

  




* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self\-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data\-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.


**Qualifications**

 We are looking for:
   

  




* 7\+ years designing and building large\-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5\+ years working with multi\-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate\-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter\-service communication patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).



  

  

 Technical Skills and Experience:
   

  




* Expert\-level Java (Java 8\+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
* Message brokers \& event streaming: Hands\-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at\-least\-once delivery, dead\-letter queues, and stream processing.
* Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade\-offs.
* Containerization \& orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
* Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry\-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
* CI/CD \& DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* OS \& systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS\-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
* Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

* Join a mission\-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business\-critical processes.
* Career development and mentorship
* A flexible, remote\-friendly company with personality and heart

Sitetracker is building Scout, our AI product line: production LLM systems and agentic workflows embedded in the software companies like Cox, Telefónica, and EVgo use to deploy critical infrastructure. You'll own features end\-to\-end, work with frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI), and see your work land in the hands of enterprise users deploying telecom networks, EV chargers, and renewable energy around the world.

You'll design, build, test, deploy, and monitor AI product features end\-to\-end , building agentic LLM systems with multi\-agent workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering over frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.
   

  

 You'll work across the full stack: backend services in Python, Java, Node.js, or Go, and TypeScript/React frontends spanning both web and mobile app experiences. You'll make AI dependable by building automated evaluation pipelines, guardrails, and testing strategies for non\-deterministic outputs — and running it on production infrastructure: scalable, fault\-tolerant services on AWS and Kubernetes.
   

  

 You'll think like a product engineer, not a ticket\-taker: dig into user needs, absorb the problem space, make smart calls about what to build, keep stakeholders informed, and find ways to unblock yourself.
   

  

 The Skills You’ll Have:
   

  

**Full\-Stack Product Engineering**
* Build production backend services in one or more of Python (FastAPI or similar), Java, Node.js, or Go

* Design REST APIs and data models across relational and NoSQL databases

* Own the quality of your features in production: monitoring, evals, and iteration

Inviting applications for the role of
 **Forward Deployed Engineer\- Insurance\- Life** 
 3
 



  





  





 About the Role
 



  





 Genpact is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of client operations, engineering, and AI product delivery for our Insurance and Financial Services portfolio. This is a hands\-on, embedded engineering role — you will work directly inside client environments (or client\-facing pods) to rapidly design, build, and iterate on agentic AI, automation, and data solutions that solve real operational problems: claims processing, underwriting workbenches, policy servicing, cash application, submission intake, and back\-office transformation.
 



  





 Unlike a traditional delivery or pre\-sales role, the FDE is expected to write code, configure platforms, and ship working solutions in close partnership with client business and IT stakeholders — compressing the gap between problem discovery and production deployment.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 · Embed directly with client teams (Insurance carriers, TPAs, FinServ operations) to understand workflows, pain points, and data landscapes firsthand — not through requirements documents alone.
 



  





 · Rapidly prototype and productionize AI\-enabled solutions: agentic workflows, LLM\-based extraction/classification, RPA \+ AI hybrid automations, and API\-first integrations.
 



  





 · Own the full build lifecycle — from architecture and proof\-of\-concept through UAT, hypercare, and steady\-state handover — often with minimal dedicated engineering support.
 



  





 · Translate ambiguous business asks (e.g., "reduce submission turnaround time," "automate cash application matching") into scoped technical designs and working prototypes within days, not months.
 



  





 · Integrate with core insurance/FinServ systems — policy admin systems, claims platforms, document management, CRM (Salesforce), and legacy mainframe/ODS environments.
 



  





 · Partner with Solution Architects, Automation Architects, and AI Architects to ensure builds align to enterprise patterns (event\-driven architecture, canonical data models, API\-first integration).
 



  





 · Instrument solutions for measurable outcomes: FTE release, STP rate, FPY, cycle time reduction, and defect/UAT pass\-rate tracking.
 



  





 · Act as the technical credibility layer in CXO/client governance forums — able to demo live builds, defend architecture choices, and respond to technical objections in real time.
 



  





 · Drive from pilot to scale: once a build proves value with one client/process, generalize it into a reusable asset or platform capability.
 



  





 · Provide technical inputs into RFP/proposal responses and BaFO (Best and Final Offer) stages when needed.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



  





 Experience \& Domain
 



  





 · 10–15 years in software/solutions engineering, with at least 5–7 years working directly in Insurance (P\&C, Life, Group Benefits) and/or Financial Services operations or technology.
 



  





 · Demonstrated experience deploying solutions into live client environments — not just internal R\&D or lab settings.
 



  





 · Working knowledge of insurance domain processes: underwriting, claims, policy servicing, submissions, cash/reconciliation, or loss run processing.
 



  





 Technical Skills
 



  





 · Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; SQL fluency mandatory).
 



  





 · Practical experience building with LLMs/agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and RAG architectures.
 



  





 · Experience with RPA and intelligent automation platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate) and where to use automation vs. AI vs. workflow engines.
 



  





 · API integration and iPaaS experience (MuleSoft or equivalent); understanding of event\-driven architecture and Canonical Data Models.
 



  





 · Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and standard MLOps/LLMOps practices for deploying and monitoring models in production.
 



  





 · Comfortable working with legacy and modern data layers alike — mainframe extracts, ODS, CDC pipelines, and modern data warehouses.
 



  





 Ways of Working
 



  





 · Bias for building over documenting — comfortable operating with incomplete specs and iterating live with client stakeholders.
 



  





 · Able to context\-switch between deep technical work and CXO\-facing conversations in the same day.
 



  





 · Strong ownership mindset: will independently drive a build from whiteboard to production without waiting for a formal handoff.
 



  





 · Experience operating in a multi\-client, multi\-workstream delivery environment, balancing competing priorities and governance cadences (QBRs, UAT tracking, RAG status reporting).
 



  





 Nice to Have
 



  





 · Prior experience in a professional services, systems integrator, or BPO transformation environment.
 



  





 · Exposure to change management frameworks (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter) for driving adoption of AI/automation solutions.
 



  





 · Prior forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or field engineering title at a product or AI company.
 



  





  





 Education

 The
 **Air Filters \& Ranking**

 **filters**
