title: Senior SAP ABAP Developer
description:
**Position Overview** 




  





 The Senior SAP ABAP Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality SAP solutions across on\-premise and SAP BTP ABAP environments. The role focuses on building scalable, efficient, and maintainable applications, leveraging advanced ABAP techniques and modern programming models.
 



  





 As a technical lead, the developer collaborates closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust technical designs. They drive solution architecture, enforce development standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure performance optimization and clean\-core principles are followed across implementations.
 



  





 The role also involves developing advanced extensions and integrations using SAP BTP, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), and cloud\-native approaches. Additionally, the Senior ABAP Developer mentors junior team members, promotes best practices, and contributes to continuous innovation within the SAP landscape.
 



  





**Shift Timings: 01:00 \- 09:30PM IST** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* First level contact for the Business Analysts for any inquiries re: application or technical support and potential technical solutions.
* Analyzes business requirements and functional specifications to determine effective technical solutions to support the business across multiple entities (divisions, functions, countries)
* Provide technical solutions and governance for SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP solutions, ensuring compliance with architecture standards, development guidelines, and best practices.
* Designs complex solutions across multiple functions, business units, technical tools and/or systems.
* Designs, codes, tests, and implements new application programs and/or modifies existing programs.
* Considers trade\-offs between performance, scalability, reliability, availability, maintainability, manageability and business requirements.
* Provides post implementation application support and regular system maintenance and support which will periodically require evening, weekend, and on\-call support.
* Support new project initiatives as a Senior Developer, designing and building SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP objects to meet business and technical requirements.
* Act as a senior technical authority, providing hands‑on guidance, problem resolution, and design support for complex development and integration scenarios.
* May function as Team and/or Project lead responsible for completion of project phase.
* Recommend and promote platform and industry best practices, including cloud‑ready development approaches and clean core principles



  





**Required Qualifications** 









 Level of Education and Discipline
 



  





 Bachelors or Maters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 



  





**Certification and/or Licenses** 




  





 SAP Backend Developer – ABAP Cloud
 



 SAP Backend Developer – Cloud Application Programming Model
 



 Any SAP Development Cloud related certification
 



  





**Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen** 




  




* 5\-8 years of experience working in the SAP ecosystem (required)
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience in SAP BTP ABAP development (required)
* Proven experience delivering and governing SAP ABAP solutions in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong hands‑on expertise in:
* SAP S/4HANA ABAP development
* SAP BTP ABAP Environment
* SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)
* RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP)
* Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM)
* SAP Build
* SAP BTP Workflow
* Demonstrated understanding of modern programming paradigms and cloud‑based extension models
* Strong business and functional acumen, enabling translation of enterprise requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions








**Interpersonal Skills \- leadership, interactions, communication, influence** 









 Ability to develop effective working relationships. Demonstrated organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Acts as a mentor within team and across GBS and proactively shares knowledge. Interacts with peers to manager. Interacts with peers to director (presents to and interacts with function heads and steering committees) Performs role in a professional manner with the ability to develop effective working relationships.

title: TDL / TALLY PRIME DEVELOPER
description:
WE ARE HIRING: TDL / TALLY PRIME DEVELOPER
 



 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Experience: 4–8\+ years
 



 Employment: Full\-time
 



 We are looking for an experienced, hands\-on TDL Developer / Tally Prime Specialist to develop and support a customised Tally\-based system connecting approximately 50 C\&F locations with our Head Office.
 



 This is primarily a Tally/TDL and systems role — not a conventional accounting position.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Develop and customise Tally Prime using TDL
 



 • Customise invoices, reports, masters and workflows
 



 • QR code generation and printing on invoices/documents
 



 • Import/export and integration of data between Tally and external applications
 



 • API/JSON/XML\-based integration where required
 



 • Configure multi\-location Tally and data synchronisation/replication
 



 • Enable individual C\&F locations to continue working locally during temporary connectivity/server interruptions
 



 • Consolidate data and provide visibility at Head Office
 



 • Automate routine data entry and reconciliation processes
 



 • Troubleshoot, deploy and support customised Tally installations
 



 • Work with our IT and accounts teams to implement the complete system
 



 The Ideal Candidate
 



 We are looking for someone who has actually built and deployed TDL customisations in live business environments.
 



 Strong practical knowledge of:
 



 • Tally Prime and TDL
 



 • Multi\-location Tally environments
 



 • Tally data synchronisation
 



 • Invoice and report customisation
 



 • QR/barcode integration
 



 • Data import/export and third\-party integration
 



 • GST\-related Tally configurations
 



 • Local/server/network\-based Tally installations
 



 Knowledge of VPN/private\-network configuration would be an advantage, although specialist network support can be provided separately.
 



 The person should be capable of understanding a business workflow, designing the Tally solution and taking responsibility for implementation — rather than merely operating Tally.
 



 Candidates who have independently implemented similar multi\-location Tally/TDL projects will be preferred.
 



 Please apply with:
 


1. Current location
2. Total Tally/TDL experience
3. Examples of major TDL customisations completed
4. Experience with multi\-location Tally synchronisation
5. Earliest date you can join

title: Senior Delivery AI Software Engineer
description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| Bengaluru
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team you will work closely with consulting teams on a diverse range of advanced topics. You will have the opportunity to leverage software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG's Consulting \& X (case) teams, X Product teams and Practice Areas (domain) through providing software developer subject matter expertise, and accelerated execution support.
   

  

 You will collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs. You will provide technical support through deeper understanding of relevant software solutions and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of concepts/Minimum viable product to long term cases with enterprise grade software development as a critical enabler through the project level description of the role responsibilities and impact within the organization.
   

  

**You're Good At**
 Web Application Development
   

  

* End to End high scale web\-development experience but not just limited to architecting, design, planning, development and deployment
* Maintains a strong knowledge base of new opensource tech stacks, applications, techniques, and skills
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills; must be proactive and take initiative
* Create robust proprietary code and translate business logic into project requirements
* Develop code using development best practices, and an emphasis on security best practices
* Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems
* Provide system design recommendations based on technical requirements
* Work independently on development tasks with minimal supervision
* Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high\-quality software delivery


 GenAI \& Agentic Systems Engineering
   

  

* Designing and shipping enterprise\-grade GenAI features inside full stack architectures — not standalone notebooks or demos

* Using AI\-assisted development tooling to accelerate your own delivery, with judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't


 Business Requirement Gathering and Collaboration
   

  

* Owning all or part of a software development engagement and integrating with cross\-functional teams
* Establish credibility by thought partnering with demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on web development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies
* Communicate insights through sophisticated synthesis and packaging of results (including PPT slides and charts) with stakeholders / consulting teams; collecting, synthesizing, learnings \& inputs into new best practices and methodologies
* Executing software development approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection
* Ensure proper sign‐off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents

* Guides juniors on advanced software concepts and platforms, and helps in quality checks
* Contributes to team’s content \& IP development
* Imparts technical trainings to team members and consulting cohort


 Problem Solving
   

  

* You should be strong in solutioning with hands\-on experience in software delivery, through the entire life cycle of software development. Strong problem solving skills with the ability to develop and codify knowledge and provide appropriate technical advice where required
* Comfort working with non\-deterministic systems — debugging by evidence and evaluation rather than assumption

 Must have

* Leveraging SQL\-Postgres for best performance
* On OOPs concepts, design patterns, responsive UI and Unit testing frameworks like Mockito, Junit, Jest.
* Knowledge of Material UI or And Design
* Knowledge of UI component libraries to produce high\-quality production apps following a high\-fidelity design and a specification
* Track record of designing, developing and supporting highly scalable, responsive web app

* Implementing tool / function calling and structured output, including schema validation and error handling
* Logging, tracing and evaluating AI output (LangSmith, Langfuse, Azure AI evaluation tooling or equivalent)


 Working knowledge
   

  

* Unix command\-line tools and code repo Git
* CI/CD, DevOps tools

title: Research Engineer, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Engineer, AI** 
 to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.
   

  

 You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build AI systems that do real work by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* Push the frontier of document intelligence by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* Define how we measure AI quality by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* Run experiments that change decisions by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Research Scientist, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Scientist, AI** 
 to invent the methods that make our AI systems more accurate, more reliable and more autonomous than anything available off the shelf.
   

  

 You'll work on the hardest open problems in our stack: agents that act reliably across unfamiliar government portals, models that reason over messy real\-world documents, and systems that know when they don't know. You'll set the research direction, run careful experiments and partner with our Research Engineers to turn breakthroughs into production gains in approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with deep research expertise who is energised by problems that don't have a paper to copy yet, and who measures success by real\-world impact, not just benchmark scores.
   

  

**The Job**
* Set and drive a research agenda on open problems in agentic AI, including how LLM\-powered agents plan, use tools, take actions and recover from errors over long, multi\-step tasks.
* Develop new methods for multimodal understanding and reasoning, so models can reliably extract, verify and reason over noisy, unstructured real\-world inputs across formats and languages.
* Design and run post\-training research, including fine\-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning, to push model capabilities beyond what general\-purpose frontier models offer.
* Research calibration, uncertainty estimation and self\-verification so AI systems know when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human.
* Build evaluations, benchmarks and synthetic data methods that give an honest picture of model quality, robustness and failure modes, especially on the long tail.
* Collaborate closely with research engineers to take ideas from prototype to production, and share findings through internal write\-ups and, where appropriate, publications.


**The Ideal Candidate**

title: Lead - MBD Validation (EV Controls)
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead \- MBD Validation (EV Controls)
 



  





 Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi
 



  





 Technical Skills Required:
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* About the role
* We design our vehicle controllers in\-house, so no Tier\-1 supplier validates the software for us. That makes validation our own quality gate between a Simulink model and a vehicle in a customer's fleet.
* You will build and run that gate: the test strategy, the MIL/SIL/PIL/HIL infrastructure, the automation, and the release sign\-off. Our vehicles run 150–250 km a day in commercial duty, so a field fault means lost revenue for a fleet operator, not just a warranty claim.
* Key responsibilities
* **Validation strategy and process**
* • Define the V\-model validation strategy for each controller: what is proven at MIL, SIL, PIL, HIL and vehicle level, and what exit criteria each stage needs.
* • Derive test cases from system and software requirements, with bidirectional traceability (requirements ↔ model ↔ test ↔ result).
* • Set and enforce model quality gates: MAAB/JMAAB modelling guidelines, Model Advisor checks, and structural coverage targets (decision, condition, MC/DC as needed).
* • Own software release sign\-off: no controller build ships to production or fleet without a validation report from your team.
* **Model and code\-level testing**
* • Run unit and integration testing on Simulink/Stateflow models using Simulink Test, Test Manager and harnesses.
* • Run back\-to\-back (MIL vs SIL/PIL) equivalence testing on auto\-generated Embedded Coder / TargetLink code.
* • Drive static analysis and run\-time error checks on generated and handwritten C (Polyspace or equivalent, MISRA C).
* • Build and maintain plant models (motor, inverter, battery, charger, vehicle dynamics) fit for closed\-loop testing.
* **HIL and test infrastructure**
* • Own the HIL benches (dSPACE SCALEXIO or equivalent): architecture, I/O and CAN configuration, fault\-injection, and commissioning of new rigs.
* • Build test automation (Python, AutomationDesk / ECU\-TEST or equivalent) with nightly regression runs integrated into CI (Jenkins/GitLab).
* • Cover fault\-injection and edge cases the vehicle can't safely reproduce: sensor failures, CAN loss, thermal derating, over/under\-voltage, contactor faults.
* **Vehicle and field validation**
* • Plan and support vehicle\-level validation with the T\&V team, using CAN logs (CANoe/CANalyzer) to close the loop between bench and road.
* • Triage field and fleet issues back to root cause in model or code, and add a regression test for every escaped defect.
* **Team and cross\-functional leadership**
* • Hire, lead and mentor a team of 4–6 validation engineers.
* • Work with controls, embedded, electrical, charging and service teams, plus suppliers for sensors, cells and chargers.
* • Support functional safety (ISO 26262\) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434\) work products for validation, and prepare for ASPICE\-style process audits.
* Must\-have qualifications
* • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering; M.Tech in automotive electronics or controls preferred.
* • 8–12 years in automotive controls, with at least 5 years hands\-on in MBD testing and validation.
* • Deep MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow skills, including Simulink Test and Embedded Coder or TargetLink generated code.
* • Proven MIL and unit testing of production controller models, with coverage and traceability reporting.
* • Hands\-on HIL experience on dSPACE, NI or Vector platforms, including fault\-injection testing.
* • Working knowledge of at least two EV controllers (VCU, MCU, BMS or charger) and how they interact over CAN.
* • CAN tools fluency: CANoe/CANalyzer, DBC management, log\-based debugging.
* • Test scripting in Python for automation and log analysis.
* • Has taken at least one EV controller software release from model to production vehicle.
* Good\-to\-have qualifications
* • Set up or commissioned an EV controls lab or HIL bench from scratch.
* • ISO 26262 functional safety exposure (ASIL decomposition, safety\-case evidence from testing).
* • ISO/SAE 21434 cybersecurity awareness or certification.
* • ASPICE SWE.4–SWE.6 process experience or audit participation.
* • CI/CD for model\-based workflows (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Simulink Project, Git/SVN).
* • Static analysis with Polyspace and MISRA C compliance.
* • Battery algorithms (SOC/SOH estimation) or DC fast\-charging protocols (Bharat DC\-001, CCS2, GB/T).
* • Commercial 3W or 4W EV background, where duty cycles and fleet uptime drive requirements.

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
****Starting Date:****
 December 2026
   

  

****Contract type:****
 Full\-time and open\-ended
   

  

****Salary:****
 From 2,716,737 INR
   

  

****Location:****
 India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)
   

  

****Application closing date:****
 8th October 2026
   

  

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: IAM Development Engineer
description:
**Role and impact**
 As an
 **IAM Development Engineer at Topsoe** 
 , you will help design, develop, and maintain the integrations and platform functionality that support secure, reliable identity and access management across the organization.
   

  

 You will work with
 **SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)** 
 and a wide range of enterprise applications to enable seamless application onboarding and robust identity lifecycle processes. From analysis and design to testing, deployment, rollback, and stabilization, you will help deliver solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with Topsoe’s IAM architecture.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop and maintain IAM connectors for enterprise applications, including SAP and other connected systems.
* Configure SailPoint ISC functionality and implement provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
* Support joiner, mover, and leaver processes, access requests, access reviews, and role\-based access models.
* Support application onboarding by analyzing requirements, identity data, roles, and entitlements.
* Perform technical testing and support deployment, rollback, troubleshooting, and stabilization activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge\-transfer activities.
* Improve development processes, integration patterns, and operational practices.


**What You Will Bring**
 You have a strong background in integration and development, combined with an understanding of identity provisioning and IAM processes. You are comfortable working in a global corporate environment and collaborating with technical teams, application owners, and stakeholders.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experience With**
* REST APIs, JSON, XML, and SCIM.
* OAuth2, client credentials, certificates, tokens, and other authentication methods.
* Java, JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting and development languages.
* Git and version control systems.
* Debugging, log analysis, and technical troubleshooting.
* Identity provisioning, application integrations, and lifecycle processes.
* Clear communication, structured problem\-solving, and effective documentation.
* Experience is SailPoint (Certification will be an advantage)


**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be An Advantage**
* SailPoint certification and connector development.
* Cloud and Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) integrations.
* CI/CD processes and secure coding practices.

* SQL\-based applications and enterprise platforms.
* Designing or maintaining role\-based access models.
* Working with global teams and complex system dependencies.

title: Lead - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*

 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Software Engineer 3
description:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices\-based architectures on MongoDB. To accelerate this transition, MongoDB is building a dedicated Platform and Infrastructure team to develop the Application Modernisation Platform and Infrastructure . As we help customers modernize their application and data ecosystems, we face the challenge of deploying complex tooling into highly restrictive client environments and architecting automated verification frameworks to ensure data equivalence.
   

  

 This new team will architect the platform foundation and infrastructure that enables a "build once, run anywhere" model, ensuring our AI\-powered modernisation suite operates seamlessly regardless of a client's security or network constraints. We are looking for engineers to join this high\-visibility initiative, where you will solve unique distributed systems puzzles and help shape the future of how global enterprises leverage data and AI.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer who thrives on solving infrastructure constraints and building developer\-centric modernisation platforms with a strong background in building software testkits/frameworks. The ideal candidate will be designing and building automated frameworks that validate functional equivalence, performance benchmarks, and data integrity. From leveraging LLMs for unit test generation to building contract testing frameworks, your work will be the safety net for the world’s largest enterprise migrations.
   

  

 This role will be based in our India office in Gurgaon and offers a hybrid working model.
   

  

 Position Expectations
   

  

* Contribute high\-quality, well\-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services
* Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
* Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns
* Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems
* Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
* Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc


 Success Measures
   

  

 Within the first three months, you will have:
   

  

* Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure \& Frameworks stack
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews


 Within six months, you will have:
   

  

* Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack
* Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents


 Within 12 months, you will have:
   

  

* Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently
* Helped recruit and interview new members of the team
* Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross\-functional projects


 The ideal candidate for this role will have
   

  

* 4 years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Expertise integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into the developer workflow to automate unit test generation and edge\-case discovery

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**

title: Consultant - Openshift
description:
**About The Job**
 The Consultant exercises good judgment and is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction whilst making sound decisions to resolve moderately complex technical issues that impact one's own area. This role independently prioritizes work and meets deadlines, contributing to project success by applying technical expertise and leading specific work streams within larger engagements. This role focuses on developing client management skills and broadening technical expertise.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Strategic Consulting: Conduct architectural discovery sessions and "Design\-and\-Build" workshops to align technical solutions with business outcomes.
* Solution Delivery: Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of OpenShift Virtualization, including platform installation, networking (OVN\-K), and storage (OpenShift Data Foundation/Ceph).
* Migration Leadership: Plan and execute large\-scale VM migrations (from VMware or Hyper\-V) using the Migration Toolkit for Virtualization (MTV), ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Automation Mastery: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines using Ansible and GitOps principles to ensure repeatable, production\-ready environments.
* Client Advocacy: Act as a technical liaison between the customer and Red Hat Product Engineering, identifying product gaps and advocating for feature enhancements.


**What Will You Bring**
* Deep Virtualization Knowledge: Expert\-level understanding of KVM and QEMU. Significant experience with VMware vSphere (ESXi/vCenter) is required to facilitate migrations.
* Container Orchestration: Hands\-on experience with Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes, specifically focused on KubeVirt or running stateful workloads.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency with Ansible and Terraform for full\-stack automation.
* Enterprise Networking/Storage: Deep understanding of software\-defined networking (SDN), load balancing, and persistent storage protocols (CSI, iSCSI, Fiber Channel).
* Consulting Experience: Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations, handle project scope creep, and present complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Linux Foundations: Expert knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), including performance tuning and security hardening.


**The Following Experience Is Considered a Plus**
* Certifications: Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Virtualization.
* Industry Experience: Previous experience in a billable consulting role for a global technology firm.
* DevOps/GitOps: Familiarity with ArgoCD, Tekton, or Jenkins for CI/CD workflows.


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.
