title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 Expedia Global Payments (EGP) is looking for top engineering talent to help drive the development of our payments platform, seamlessly roll out new payments methods, and to continuously raise the bar on our operational excellence and engineering practices. Our services are the nexus of a globally distributed system that spans many organizations. Our roadmap is deep and contains several innovative programs designed to make our services fault tolerant, reduce the cost of payment processing, and improve customer experience. This includes compensating for downstream services that are not in Expedia's control. We are also looking to use cloud computing (AWS) to further solidify our infrastructure. This opportunity presents you with great technical challenges and the ability to have a tremendous business impact. We do this accurately and at scale, processing over $100 billion payments in 60\+ currencies in over 155 countries every year across diverse payment options.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build end\-to\-end backend solutions for Payments, that are scalable, resilient, and performant.
* Own and evolve core payment services and workflows, including payment session lifecycle, payment\-method orchestration, and downstream service integrations.
* Build and enhance backend APIs and service interfaces using Kotlin/Java and modern service frameworks, with strong emphasis on clean contracts, backward compatibility, and operational reliability.
* Develop and support GraphQL, gRPC, and REST\-based integrations that power payment experiences across multiple Expedia Group brands and checkout surfaces.
* Contribute to distributed system design for high\-volume, multi\-tenant, 24x7 payment flows, balancing latency, availability, security, and maintainability.
* Build robust integrations with payment providers, internal platforms, and shared infrastructure while ensuring fault tolerance and graceful degradation.
* Take strong ownership of production systems, including monitoring, alerting, on\-call participation, incident response, and root cause resolution.
* Build and enhance observability through logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and operational playbooks to proactively detect and prevent issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with urgency, minimizing customer, partner, and business impact in high\-transaction environments.
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment safety, and engineering effectiveness through CI/CD, rollback strategies, feature flags, test automation, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, frontend engineers, partner teams, and platform teams to deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable payment capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices across backend design, coding standards, testing, operational excellence, and incident management.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design decisions across the team and broader payments ecosystem.
* Influence cross\-functional delivery and act as a subject matter expert for backend payment architecture, scalability, and service reliability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low\-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS\-backed applications.
* Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale.
* Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep expertise in Java\-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database\-resident logic into application services.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability.
* Demonstrated use of AI\-augmented development or operations (for example, code\-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‑enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes.

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Product Engineer (Founding Team), RAYY
description:
**Gurugram, hybrid · Full\-time · 3–5 years · Start 1 October 2026 · Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**﻿
 
 About RAYY** 




 RAYY is a booking marketplace for sports academies, fitness classes and kids' learning
 



 activities, live in Gurugram and expanding to a second city. We are a small, fast\-moving team
 



 raising our first institutional round, and we are bringing engineering in\-house now.
 



**The role** 




 You will be one of the first two engineers at RAYY, working directly with the CPTO. The product
 



 is a Flutter customer app, a FastAPI backend on MongoDB, and Next.js dashboards for partners
 



 and our own team, on AWS. You will work end to end across all of it rather than in one layer.
 



 There is a full roadmap of customer\-facing features shipping this quarter, a backlog to clear,
 



 and releases to take over from our vendor; you will be building from day one and helping set
 



 how we build as the team grows.
 



**What you'll do** 




 Own features from API to screen across Flutter, Python and TypeScript. Fix, refactor and extend
 



 code you did not write. Ship to the Play Store and App Store and keep production healthy. Use
 



 AI coding tools as a normal part of your work, and review what they produce with the same
 



 care as your own. Write tests where they matter, especially anywhere money moves.
 



**What we're looking for** 




 Three to five years at a product company, with at least one consumer app shipped to real
 



 users; payments or marketplace experience is a plus. Working ability in at least two of Flutter,
 



 Python and TypeScript, and the willingness to work in all three. Familiarity with MongoDB, a
 



 payment gateway such as Razorpay, and AWS basics. Comfort with small teams and
 



 ambiguity: you would rather ship and learn than wait for a spec. Clear communication, since
 



 you will talk to partners and the CEO, not only to engineers. Available to start on or around 1
 



 October.
 



**Nice to have** 




 Experience at a food, fitness or booking marketplace. Prior work taking over a codebase from
 



 an agency or vendor. Flutter release tooling or Next.js.
 



**How we work** 




 Five\-day week, hybrid from our Gurugram office, with flexibility around business needs during
 



 launches and our fundraise. Small PRs, fast reviews, outcomes over hours. You will be judged
 



 on what ships and whether it stays up.
 



**Compensation** 




 Fixed salary, competitive for stage and experience.
 



**Process** 




 A short call with the CPTO, a two\-hour take\-home on our stack (use whatever tools you like; we
 



 discuss the diff together), and a conversation with the CEO. The whole loop fits in five days,
 



 and we can start you within a week of offer.
 



**To apply** 




 Send a CV or LinkedIn profile and a link to something you've shipped to hr@rayy.io with
 



 "Product Engineer" in the subject line.

 Bachelor's or Master's degree (BE/BTech/MTech/MS/MBA) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Information Technology, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related disciplines with an excellent academic record.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an AI Decision Science Analyst, you will design, develop, fine\-tune, evaluate, and deploy enterprise\-scale AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Multi\-Agent Systems. You will build intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, collaborating, and autonomously executing complex business workflows using advanced orchestration frameworks and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
   

  

 You will develop enterprise AI applications integrating with platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Teams, Splunk, Azure AI Services, Azure Functions, databases, and REST APIs to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will work closely with solution architects, product owners, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI solutions across multiple industries.

**Advanced Generative AI \& Agentic AI Development**
* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI agents using AI Refinery, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, and custom agentic architectures.
* Build intelligent multi\-agent systems capable of reasoning, planning, task decomposition, collaboration, and autonomous execution.
* Develop reusable agent orchestration frameworks, AI accelerators, and enterprise AI components.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations enabling seamless communication between AI agents and enterprise applications.
* Design Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows where business approvals or validations are required.
* Build AI copilots, autonomous agents, and workflow automation solutions for enterprise use cases.


**LLM Engineering \& AI Model Development**
* Build, fine\-tune, evaluate, and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) for enterprise use cases.
* Develop Generative AI applications using advanced prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and tool calling.
* Evaluate AI models across accuracy, latency, grounding quality, safety, hallucination rates, and business KPIs.
* Optimize prompts, agent workflows, and reasoning strategies to improve reliability and performance.
* Implement model evaluation pipelines and continuous improvement mechanisms.


**Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
* Design and implement enterprise RAG solutions using Azure AI Search, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval techniques.
* Develop document ingestion, chunking, metadata enrichment, indexing, and retrieval pipelines.
* Optimize grounding strategies and retrieval quality to improve AI response accuracy.
* Build scalable enterprise knowledge management solutions powered by LLMs.


**Enterprise AI Integration**
* Integrate AI agents with ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft Teams, Splunk, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, and REST APIs.
* Build secure MCP integrations enabling AI agents to interact with enterprise systems.
* Develop scalable enterprise automation workflows leveraging AI agent orchestration.
* Design resilient API integrations with security, authentication, logging, retries, and error handling.


**AI Governance, Evaluation \& Observability**
* Implement AI guardrails, Responsible AI principles, governance controls, and compliance standards.
* Design evaluation frameworks for measuring AI quality, grounding, latency, hallucination rates, and business outcomes.
* Build observability dashboards to monitor AI agent execution, token consumption, workflow performance, cost, and operational health.
* Ensure enterprise AI applications meet organizational security, governance, and compliance requirements.


**Solution Engineering \& Deployment**
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and engineering teams to design and deliver scalable cloud\-native AI solutions.
* Deploy AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, and enterprise cloud platforms.
* Participate in architecture, design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and MLOps practices for AI solution lifecycle management.


**Innovation \& Knowledge Sharing**
* Stay updated with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, MCP, LLMs, and enterprise AI technologies.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, templates, and best practices.


 Create technical documentation and mentor junior team members

* Understanding of multi\-agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, and planning paradigms
* Familiarity with data pipelines, model deployment, and productizing considerations
* Strong understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, APIs, and cloud\-native architectures
* Experience with foundational models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock)
* Proven experience delivering AI\-powered SaaS or internal platforms to automate workflows and enhance customer experience
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align AI strategy with enterprise goals
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with adaptability to the rapidly evolving AI landscap
* Commercial Excellence \& Business Acumen \- Strong understanding of Commercial Excellence concepts, including, but not limited to: Pricing and margin optimization; Customer segmentation and churn; Revenue analytics and growth strategy; Salesforce effectiveness; Ability to translate business problems into AI\-driven solutions
* Experience in data\-driven problem solving and executive storytelling
* Experience working with senior stakeholders to shape commercial strategy and drive adoption, including leading workshops, influencing decision\-making, and aligning cross functional teams (sales, finance, product)
* Ability to develop clear, compelling executive storylines, distilling complex analyses and AI outputs into concise recommendations for C\-suite audiences

* Take ownership of defined work modules, including analysis, data preparation, model testing, workflow configuration, documentation, and output quality checks

description:
Engineer 3, Business Systems (CPQ)
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**About Team**
 The CRM Technologies Team plays a critical role in optimizing our sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce and Quote\-to\-Cash technologies, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, and operational support needed to effectively manage quoting, pricing, approvals, and downstream business processes.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, CPQ, integrations, and platform operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM ecosystem to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Quote\-to\-Cash solutions.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a CPQ Engineer III to design, build, and support core capabilities in our Configure–Price–Quote (CPQ) stack that power how our GTM teams sell and price MongoDB offerings. As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and support Salesforce solutions across product modeling, pricing, quoting, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Configure and enhance CPQ capabilities including product rules, price rules, bundles, product options, quote templates, discounting, and approval workflows
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and deliver scalable business solutions
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and platform APIs to support related processes
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, contract, and other enterprise platforms
* Participate in technical design, story grooming, sprint planning, testing, code reviews, release management, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across CPQ configuration, pricing logic, automation, integrations, and system performance
* Support documentation, UAT, regression testing, and user enablement to improve adoption and platform reliability
* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery: Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ, utilizing a mix of declarative configuration and custom development (Apex, LWC, and Flow)
* System Architecture: Design and implement robust integrations between CPQ and downstream systems (ERP, Billing, Telemetry) to ensure data integrity across the Lead\-to\-Cash lifecycle
* Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards for code quality by implementing testable, modular solutions and contributing to shared frameworks and CI/CD best practices
* Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing CPQ flows, improving calculator speed and user experience for a global sales force
* Mentorship \& Influence: Lead peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical playbook, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering organization


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform
* Good understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, sales workflows, and Salesforce best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs
* Experience with product modeling, pricing rules, quoting workflows, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, or other enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, version control, and Salesforce release practices
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Sr. Implementation Consultant - CCAAS (AMER shift)
description:

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.

**Job Description**

 6 PM IST to 3 AM IST
   

  

 The
 **Senior CCaaS Implementation Consultant**

This role blends deep technical proficiency with business acumen and leadership, guiding cross\-functional teams, mentoring peers, and acting as a senior escalation and consulting partner to enterprise clients.

**Qualifications**

**What Success Looks Like**
* You’re a strategic advisor to clients and internal teams, driving measurable impact and platform maturity.
* You create repeatable frameworks and tools that improve team efficiency and customer outcomes.
* You proactively elevate the implementation practice by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and fostering innovation.

**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Camley Camley is building the agentic infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are leading private equity and infrastructure investment firms, and we are at the forefront of transforming a $55T asset class that still runs on spreadsheets and software built in the 1990s. What Harvey did for legal, we are doing for private markets. We are building the multi\-agent architecture that operates funds end\-to\-end, solving the highest\-stakes problems investment firms face with accuracy and speed. Our agents are not just chatbots \- they move money and execute workflows autonomously. We are backed by top VCs, incl. the first investor in Lovable and one of the most technical AI investors in Silicon Valley responsible for building Uber’s core algorithm. Camley is built by a team from Stanford, Harvard, IIT Delhi, and Penn, with decades of industry experience at McKinsey, SquarePoint, and Deutsche Bank \+ building foundation models for an Accel\-backed startup. About the role We are hiring a founding full\-stack AI engineer. You will build products end\-to\-end and shape agent architecture and technical decisions alongside the CTO. You’ll build the core intelligence layer \- language models for reading documents, a knowledge graph \& vector DB for storing data and relationships, a calculation engine for the fund mathematics and an orchestration layer that coordinates these into workflows that an auditor can sign. You'll own high\-impact features across the stack, from model integration to infrastructure. We are a small team working across London and New York. We are open to remote/hybrid for the right candidate. We are a lean team with a high bar for excellence, and hours will at times be intense as in any high\-growth startup. In return, you get the autonomy to do some of the best work of your life, and a founding team that values openness, empathy, and not taking ourselves too seriously. What you will do Design and integrate LLM\-powered pipelines and build agents that execute multi\-step workflows reliably Build the agent harness: orchestration, tool use, retries, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and optimise agent performance across prompts, models, tools, and context Own the evals, validation, audit trails, and observability that keep agent behaviour correct, explainable, and improving Ship features across our React frontend and Python backend, from database schemas and APIs to polished UI, from idea to production Work directly with the founders and early customers to understand real fund workflows, and turn operational pain into shipped product What we are looking for We are looking for an exceptional engineer who wants the autonomy to shape a product from day 0, who loves the challenge of maintaining a strong quality bar while shipping extremely quickly, and who knows how to make smart tradeoffs to get features in front of customers. Strong candidates have: Built products from 0 to 1 5\+ years of experience building production software Strong full\-stack fundamentals across frontend, backend, and infra Proficiency in Python and production experience building LLM systems/agent frameworks High ownership: you do not wait for a spec to start solving a problem Made AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) a core part of how they work Passion for building effective domain\-specific agents Bonus points if you have: Experience in finance or financial services Data\-intensive backend work Early\-stage startup experience Technology stack Typescript/React, Python (FastAPI), Postgres, AWS, and an agent orchestration layer you will help design. How to apply Apply through Wellfound and we will see it. Include your CV with the role title in the subject line. You can include your portfolio, GitHub, and what excites you about the role. Please do not submit AI generated applications.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \['Python TypeScript React.js Generative AI Agentic AI']
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 NA

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

**Description**
 Help shape the future of AI\-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production \- shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
   

  

 We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world\-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production\-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production\-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling


 This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver \- someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI\-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness \- applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine\-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high\-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities \- assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI\-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross\-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI\-generated image outputs \-tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers \- solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.

 Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products \- through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent

* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front\-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large\-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design

* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

* Build applications in Python — desktop tools, reporting systems, and backend services.

****Our Benefits****
**With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.** 
****Great Place to Work****
**Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards
 **Click Here.****
**We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com .** 
****Designation Lead programmer Analyst****
****Key Expectations****
* Own end\-to\-end technology delivery (System Analysis, Configuration, and Quality


****Assurance) for aligned benefits services or product lines.****
* Provide technical leadership through high\-level analysis, design oversight, and quality assurance sign\-offs.
* Ensure smooth production deployments and stable transition of projects into operations.
* Mentor, coach, and develop Analysts and Senior Analysts to build strong technical capability.
* Balance client expectations, delivery timelines, quality, and resource constraints effectively.


****Required Skills****
* Deep technical expertise in benefits systems and service lines.
* Strong system analysis, configuration, and QA governance capabilities.
* Project and workload management skills.
* Strong stakeholder and client communication skills.
* Ability to lead, mentor, and coach technical teams.
* Strong documentation, risk management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Expert in US Benefits administration – Health \& Welfare domain
* End to end understanding of Files lifecycle including strong understanding of Payroll including CLP process


****Role Description****
****The Lead Analyst – Technology has overall accountability for the technology work—system analysis, configuration, and quality assurance—of Alight’s proprietary benefits system for one or more aligned service or product lines, such as Health Management (HM). The role may support one or multiple clients based on business needs.****
****The Lead Analyst is responsible for creating high\-level and complex analysis, approving all system configurations, technical documentation, and testing outcomes, and ensuring alignment with client requirements and system capabilities. The role plays a critical governance function by signing off on production migrations, ensuring stability of newly released projects, and managing a smooth transition to operations for ongoing support.****
****In addition, the Lead Analyst provides strong technical leadership by coaching and mentoring Senior Analysts and Analysts on quality, technology, and client\-specific requirements. The role also involves coordinating with Project / Performance Team Managers to manage workload, address unplanned work, and ensure delivery commitments are met. Depending on business needs, the role may also include people management responsibilities.****
****Key Responsibilities****
* Partner with clients to understand technical requirements, manage expectations, and guide analysis activities.
* Define and execute integrated system and testing strategies for aligned services.
* Perform high\-level gap and impact analysis and delegate detailed analysis as appropriate.
* Oversee data conversion, interface strategy, and integration with Shared Services.
* Ensure maintenance of regression test plans and integration of test execution and quality.
* Lead deployment execution, production stabilization, and system abend monitoring.
* Drive precise technical documentation, including gap analysis and transition artifacts.
* Foster a collaborative and performance\-driven team environment.


****Education:****
* B.Tech (CS / IT / ECE) or MCA – mandatory Experience
* Prior experience with Alight / Aon / Wipro is an added advantage
* Health or Retirement Domain experience preferred
* Experience in development and implementation of software solutions
* Strong project management experience


****Application and Interview****
**By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.** 
**Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera\-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.** 
****Our commitment to Inclusion****
**We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.**
**SSN/SIN to be replaced with Government ID to get aligned with India context**
 We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education \& training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.
   

  

**DISCLAIMER:**
 Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

title: Platform Engineer (Developer Experience & Internal Tooling)
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon / Remote (Hybrid / Flexible Work Policy)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 3–6 Years
   

  

**Industry\-Standard Salary Range:** 
 20 LPA – 34 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 At our core, we are a fast\-growing, product\-driven technology company building mission\-critical B2B SaaS solutions for global supply chain logistics and high\-throughput fintech settlement rails. Our platform ingests millions of data points every single hour, runs complex vector searches, and powers real\-time enterprise dashboards relied upon by thousands of business\-critical users worldwide.
   

  

 However, we firmly believe that external product velocity is directly bottlenecked by internal engineering efficiency. As our engineering organization scales rapidly across multiple squads—spanning backend microservices, data warehousing, machine learning, and frontend interfaces—maintaining developer velocity, standardization, and infrastructure reliability becomes our biggest operational leverage. We are building a dedicated Platform Engineering function to create a world\-class Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that treats developers as our primary "users." If you are passionate about building abstractions, automating cloud infrastructure, and eliminating cognitive friction so engineers can ship secure code with a single click, you will find your ultimate engineering home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary, hands\-on
 **Platform Engineer (Developer Experience \& Internal Tooling)** 
 to take ownership of our internal infrastructure automation, developer portals, CI/CD templates, and shared deployment primitives. In this role, you will work at the intersection of DevOps, software engineering, and security. You won't just write scripts; you will architect self\-service developer workflows that abstract away the complexity of Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud networking. Your work will directly accelerate our deployment frequency, reduce lead times for changes, and enforce enterprise\-grade security and compliance standards natively across all engineering squads without slowing them down.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Architecture: Design, build, and scale our custom internal developer portal and self\-service provisioning cli tools, enabling engineers to spin up microservices, databases, and staging environments in minutes.
* CI/CD Pipeline Standardization: Architect, optimize, and maintain reusable, hardened CI/CD pipeline templates (via GitHub Actions) that incorporate automated testing, security scanning (SAST/DAST), and container building out\-of\-the\-box.
* Kubernetes \& Infrastructure Automation: Manage core Kubernetes cluster primitives, service meshes (such as Istio or Linkerd), ingress controllers, and immutable infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Atlantis.
* Developer Onboarding \& Experience: Streamline local development workflows using Docker, Devcontainers, and micro\-service scaffolding tools to reduce new engineer ramp\-up time from weeks to days.
* Observability \& Guardrails Integration: Implement monitoring for internal platform services, establish feedback loops for build performance, and embed compliance guardrails directly into developer self\-service workflows.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Security, DevOps, and Product Engineering squads to understand pain points, collect feedback, and continuously iterate on internal tooling architecture.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Automation, or senior DevOps roles within high\-growth tech product companies.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt), and modern CI/CD orchestration engines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Programming Fluency: Strong scripting and software development skills in Go, Python, or Bash, with the ability to build robust internal command\-line utilities and automation services.
* Cloud Competency: Comprehensive hands\-on experience managing cloud architecture, IAM security policies, networking, and serverless compute primitives on AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Empathy \& Communication: Strong product mindset with an empathetic approach toward developer experience, exceptional documentation skills, and a collaborative attitude.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-leading salary package (20–34 LPA) structured with base pay, performance bonuses, and meaningful equity participation.
* Modern Tech Stack \& Autonomy: Full ownership over platform choices, architecture designs, and internal tool adoption.
* Growth \& Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents, plus an annual learning stipend for certifications and tech conferences.

title: GDS Cyber - Frontier AI-VMDR - Senior Engineer
description:
